64 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/ tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang / /rtogs brjod de lta bu byung dang / /skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa dang / /rmad byung gtan la dbab pa dang / /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis yin/ /zhes so/ /de la mdo'i sde ni/ gang bzhed pa'i don smos pa'i tshul gyis rkyang bar gsungs pa'o/ /ci'i phyir phye ste ma gsungs zhe na/ kun btus su/ phan yon bcu gzigs nas de bzhin gshegs pa smos pa'i tshul gyis chos ston te/ rnam par gzhag sla ba dang / bshad sla ba dang / gzung sla ba dang / chos la gus pas myur du tshogs yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / myur du chos nyid rtogs par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas la shes nas dad pa thob pa dang / chos dang dge 'dun la shes nas dad pa thob pa dang / mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa'i mchog la reg pa dang / 'bel ba'i gtam gyis gtan la 'bebs pas dam pa rnams kyi sems mgu bar byed de/ mkhas pa mkhas pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o zhes so/ /dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'i sde ni/ mdo sde de nyid du dbus dang mtha' mar tshigs su bcad de dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'am drang ba'i don gyi mdo sde rtogs par byed pas dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'o/ /lung du bstan pa'i sde ni/ nyan thos 'das te shi ba'i dus byas pa dang 'byung ba lung ston pa dam pa'i chos pad ma dkar po lta bu'am/yang na/ nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde ni/ des rnam par phye nas dgongs pa lung ston pa'i phyir lung du bstan pa'i sde'o/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i sde ni/ tshigs bcad du

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 65sbyar nas gsungs pa ste/ de ni rtsa ba gnyis pa/ dge slong 'di ni ston pa ste/ /nye bar zhi zhing zag pa zad/ /ces pa lta bu dang / rtsa ba gsum pa/ 'di na bdag gam sems can med/ /srog kyang yod pa ma yin te/ /chos 'di rgyu dang bcas las byung / /zhes pa lta bu dang / rtsa ba bzhi pa/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /zhes sogs lta bu dang / rtsa ba lnga pa dang rtsa ba drug pa/ 'di dag 'khrul ba'i snang ba ste/ /rmi lam nyams su myong ba bzhin/ /ma rig mun pa'i gnyid sad na/ /'khor ba rnams ni dmigs su med/ /de yi phyir na 'ga' zhig la/ /blo skye med pa sangs rgyas yin/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /ched du brjod pa'i sde ni/ rnam bshad rigs par/gang zag gi ched du gsungs pa ma yin gyi/ bstan pa gnas par bya ba 'ba' zhig gi phyir bshad pa gang yin pa ste zhes so/ /gang yid rangs nas brjod pa ste/dper na/ thub pas snod bcud kyi zhing sbyangs pa na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis dul ba ni legs so/ /zhi ba ni legs so zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gleng gzhi'i sde ni/ gang zag 'ga' zhig gi ched du gsungs pa dang byung ba dang bcas pa'i bslab pa bcas pa gsungs pa ste/ nor can la ma byin len gyi bslab pa bcos pa lta bu'o/ /rtogs pa brjod pa'i sde ni/ dpe dang bcas par gsungs pa ste/ dpe don gsal bar byed ba'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu byung ba'i sde ni/sngon gyi sbyor ba dang ldan pa ste/ skem mo go ta ma'i gtam rgyud lta bu'o/ /skyes pa rabs kyi sde ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ston pa ste/ thams cad sgrol gyi rnam thar lta bu'o/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i sde ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod dang ldan pa ste/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i gnas yin pa dang rgyas pa dang rgya che ba dang zab pa'i rnam par chos ston pa'i phyir ro/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam

66 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/par 'thag pas rnam par 'thag pa zhes bya'o/ /gzhan dang mtshungs pa med pas mtshungs bral zhes bya'o/ /chen po bdun dang ldan pas theg pa chen po zhes bya'o/ /rmad du byung ba'i sde ni/ nyan thos dang byang sems dang sangs rgyas rnams kyi ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos bstan pa'o/ /gtan la phab par bstan pa'i sde ni/gang du chos kyi mtshan nyid phyin ci ma log par bstan pas mdo la sogs pa'i don bshad pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sde snod gsum ste/ 'di la yan lag bcu gnyis sde snod gsum du bsdu ba dang / sde snod kyi nges tshig dang / sde snod gsum du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / sde snod so so'i nges tshig go /dang po ni/ mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan tshigs bcad ched brjod lnga nyan thos kyi mdo sde'i sde snod do/ /gleng gzhi'i sde ni/ byung ba dang bcas pa'i bslab pa gsungs pa 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi gtso bo yin la/ rtogs brjod de lta bu byung ba skyes rabs gsum ni/ de'i 'khor yin pas de ltar bzhi ni 'dul ba'i sde snod do/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i sde dang rmad du byung ba'i sde ni byang chub sems dpa'i mdo sde'i sde snod de/ byang sems dang sangs rgyas de dag gi khyad par gyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab cing rgya che ba'i khyad par dang ldan pa'i phyir rmad du byung ba yang byang sems kyi mdo sder bsdu'o/ /gtan la phab par bstan pa'i sde ni/ theg chen dang nya na thos gnyis ka'i mngon pa'i sde snod do/ /sdud tshul 'di kun las btus kyi lugs yin no/ /gzhan du gzhan bshad pa'ang yod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ saṃ skṛ ta la pi ṭa ka zhes 'byung zhing paṇ+ḍi ta zhes bsgyur na gong bu'am bsdus pa ste/ don mang po brjod byar bsdus pa'am shes bya thams cad

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 67brjod byar bsdus pas sde snod do/ /yang na/ pi ṭa ka zhes pa yul dbus kyi bre bo che'i ming yin la/ bre bo che'i nang du bre'u chung mang po 'dus pa bzhin du 'di dag gi nang du brjod bya bslab bya mang po 'dus pas sde snod do/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyu dgus sde snod gsum du gzhag ste/ spang bya la bltos nas gsum dang / bslab bya la bltos nas gsum dang / shes bya la bltos nas gsum du bzhag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ nye ba'i nyon mongs pa the tshom gyi gnyen por mdo sde'i sde snod bzhag ste/ gdul bya rnams kyi bden pa dang dkon mchog sogs la som nyi byung ba gcad pa'i ched du mdo'i sde la sogs pa bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /nye ba'i nyon mongs pa mtha' gnyis dang ldan pa'i gnyen por 'dul ba'i sde snod bzhag ste/ 'dod pa bsod nyams kyi mtha' chags shing zhen pas gsog 'jog la spyod pa'i gnyen por gsog 'jog cung zad tsam yang bkag cing / tshul khrims dag pas zhen med du lhag par rnyed na khang pa brtsegs pa lnga brgya ba'am kha zas ro brgya pa'am/ gar+sha pa ni brgya stong ri ba'i gos la sogs pa'ang gnang bas ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' spong ba'o/ /rang gi lta ba mchog tu 'dzin pa'i nye nyon gyi gnyen por mngon pa'i sde snod bzhag ste/ der chos kyi mtshan nyid rgya cher bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ bslab pa gsum brjod pa'i phyir mdo sde ste/ de las bslab pa gsum rgyas par brjod pas gdul bya rnams bslab pa gsum la byang bar byed do/ /tshul khrims dang sems kyi bslab pa bsgrub pa'i phyir 'dul ba ste/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa'i bslab pa la brten nas dngos su tshul khrims yongs su sbyong zhing de dag pas 'gyod pa med pa la sogs pa'i rim gyis sems mnyam par 'jog pa'i

68 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/phyir ro/ /shes rab kyi bslab pa bsgrub pa'i phyir mngon pa ste/ der chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i thabs rgya cher bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ chos dang don brjod pa'i phyir mdo sde ste/ des tshig don la byang bar byed do/ /chos dang don mngon du bya ba'i gzhi'i gnas kyi phyir 'dul ba ste/des 'dul ba'i sde snod ni bslab pa sgrub pas rab tu phye bas tshul khrims dag pas ting nge 'dzin skye/ des nyon mongs pa 'dul bas chos dang don mngon du byed do/ /mngon pa la brten nas phan tshun 'bel ba'i gtam gyis gtan la 'bebs pa las gyur pa'i chos la rdzogs par longs spyod pas bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur te/ der chos rnams kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid la sogs pa'i chos nyid la byang bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i sde snod gsum la thos pa byas pas bag chags 'jog go /bsam pas don rtogs par byed do/ /bsgoms pas zhi gnas kyi sems kyis nyon mongs pa zhi bar byed la/ lhag mthong gis chos nyid rab tu rtogs pas sa bon las grol bar byed do/ /de dag la dgongs nas/ mdo sde rgyan nazla5/sde snod dag ni gsum mam gnyis kyang rung / /bsdus pa'i phyir te rgyu ni dgus 'dod do/ /de ni bag chags rtogs dang zhi ba dang / /rab tu rtogs pas rnam par grol bar byed/ /ces so/ /bzhi pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan nas/

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 69mdo dang chos mngon 'dul ba dag /mdor na don ni rnam bzhir 'dod/ /blo dang ldan pas de shes nas/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa thob/ /ces pa'i don zhes pa sgra don nam nges tshig yin gyi/ mtshan nyid du 'chad pa nor ba yin no/ /blo dang ldan pa byang sems kyis sde snod gsum ma lus pa shes pas rnam mkhyen 'thob bo/ /nyan thos kyis tshigs bcad gcig gi don shes pas 'bras bu 'thob ste/ shā ri'i bu'am lam phran bstan bzhin no/ /de la mdo'i saṃ skṛ ta la sla tra zhes pa/ mgo smos par 'gyur te/ rgyal po'i khab na zhes pa lta bu gnas smos pa dang / sa'i mtshan nyid ni/ sra ba'o zhes pa lta bu mtshan nyid smos pa dang / chos kyi tshig smos pa dang don smos pas mdo de 'dra'i tshogs su gyur pas sde'o/ /gnas rnams dang ni mtshan nyid dang / /chos don smos phyir mdo yin no/ /zhes so/ /mngon pa la/ saṃ skṛ ta la a bhi zhes pa'i a bhi mu khya zhes pa mngon du gyur pa ste/ de kho na nyid mngon sum du gyur pas mngon pa ste/ mngon pa mtshan nyid pa'o/ /a bhi k+ṣa na zhes pa yang yang ste/ phung khams skye mched rdzas yod btags yod la sogs sgo du ma nas yang yang ston pas mngon pa ste/ gzhung lugs so/ /a bhi bhu zhes pa zil gnon te/ de las chos rnams kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid ma lus pa shes pas 'bel ba'i gtam gyis gtan la 'bebs pas gzhan zil gyis gnon pa'am smra ba ngan pa rnams zil gyis gnon pa'o/ /a bhi sa ma ya zhes pa rtogs pa ste/shes bya ji snyed pa rdzas btags sogs rtogs pas mngon pa'o/ /mngon du'i phyir

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 69mdo dang chos mngon 'dul ba dag /mdor na don ni rnam bzhir 'dod/ /blo dang ldan pas de shes nas/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa thob/ /ces pa'i don zhes pa sgra don nam nges tshig yin gyi/ mtshan nyid du 'chad pa nor ba yin no/ /blo dang ldan pa byang sems kyis sde snod gsum ma lus pa shes pas rnam mkhyen 'thob bo/ /nyan thos kyis tshigs bcad gcig gi don shes pas 'bras bu 'thob ste/ shā ri'i bu'am lam phran bstan bzhin no/ /de la mdo'i saṃ skṛ ta la sla tra zhes pa/ mgo smos par 'gyur te/ rgyal po'i khab na zhes pa lta bu gnas smos pa dang / sa'i mtshan nyid ni/ sra ba'o zhes pa lta bu mtshan nyid smos pa dang / chos kyi tshig smos pa dang don smos pas mdo de 'dra'i tshogs su gyur pas sde'o/ /gnas rnams dang ni mtshan nyid dang / /chos don smos phyir mdo yin no/ /zhes so/ /mngon pa la/ saṃ skṛ ta la a bhi zhes pa'i a bhi mu khya zhes pa mngon du gyur pa ste/ de kho na nyid mngon sum du gyur pas mngon pa ste/ mngon pa mtshan nyid pa'o/ /a bhi k+ṣa na zhes pa yang yang ste/ phung khams skye mched rdzas yod btags yod la sogs sgo du ma nas yang yang ston pas mngon pa ste/ gzhung lugs so/ /a bhi bhu zhes pa zil gnon te/ de las chos rnams kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid ma lus pa shes pas 'bel ba'i gtam gyis gtan la 'bebs pas gzhan zil gyis gnon pa'am smra ba ngan pa rnams zil gyis gnon pa'o/ /a bhi sa ma ya zhes pa rtogs pa ste/shes bya ji snyed pa rdzas btags sogs rtogs pas mngon pa'o/ /mngon du'i phyir

70 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/dang yang yang phyir/ /zil gnon rtogs phyir mngon pa'i chos/ /zhes so/ /'dul ba la/ bi na ya zhes pa'i bi bitrī zhes pa/ rnam par lhung ba ste/ lhung ba ston cing nges par byed pas 'dul ba zhes pa la sogs pa'am/ bi ni sh+tsa ya zhes pa/ rnam par nges pas 'dul ba zhes sogs bzhi tshan gnyis gsungs te/ lhung dang 'byung dang ldang ba dang / /nges par 'byung dang gang zag dang / /bcas pa dang ni rab dbye dang / /rnam par nges phyir 'dul ba nyid/ /ces so/ /lnga pa ni/ rgyan las/ gnyis kyang rung zhes pas/ dman pa la mos pa la nyan thos kyi sde snod dang / rgya chen po la mos pa la theg pa chen po'i sde snod do/ /theg pa che chung gi khyad par ni chen po bdun dang ldan pas sam/ theg bsdus las/shes bya'i gnas dang mtshan nyid der 'jug dang / /de yi rgyu 'bras de rab dbye ba dang / /bslab pa gsum dang de 'bras spangs pa dang / /ye shes theg pa mchog gyur khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /des na nyan thos kyi lugs kyis shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod ni mdo sde le'u'i grangs shin tu mang zhing rgyas pa la 'dod do/ /theg chen lugs kyis shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod ni nges pa'i tshig gi tshul gyis theg pa rgyas pas na shin tu rgyas pa ste/ stong phrag brgya pa la sogs pa dang ldan pas chos chen po dang / sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pas sems bskyed pa chen po dang / chos shin tu zab pa dang rgya che ba la mos pas mos pa che ba dang / bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i bsam pa thob pas bsam pa rgya chen po dang / sar

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 71chud nas skad cig re re la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa gsog pas tshogs chen po dang / bskal pa grangs med gsum du brtson pas dus chen po dang / sems can thams cad dang mi mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku 'grub pas yang dag par 'grub pa chen po ste/ chen po bdun dang ldan pas theg chen no/ /mdo sde rgyan las chen po bdun 'di las cung zad mi 'dra bar 'byung ngo / /yang dbang po rtul po rgyu la mos pas rgyu lam du byed pa la/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / rnon po rgyu 'bras lhun grub la mos pa la 'bras bu lam du byed pa 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis yin te/ mdo sde gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal po las/'jam dpal gyis/ lta'iphags pa gsang ba lung bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs so zhes dz+nya na shrīs rdo rje theg pa'i mtha' gnyis sel bar gsungs so/ )/'dren pa'i theg pa gsum po dag / bcom ldan nges par gsungs lags na/ /rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod cing / /sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'asna'il ba'i/ /nges pa'i theg pa cis ma gsungs/ /zhes sdo/sa pa dang /rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /

72 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/zhes so/ /sngags mtshan nyid kyi khyad par de slob dpon tri pi ṭa ka ma la'i tshul gsum gyi sgron me las/don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pas phyi'i thabs smad nas nang ting nge 'dzin gyis phar phyin drug sgrub pas thabs la ma rmongs pa dang / shin tu phra ba sems sems byung dang / phra ba ngag yi ge dang / rags pa rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa thugs gsung sku'i ting nge 'dzin dang / yang dag pa'i don ston pas thabs mang ba dang / gdul bya gang 'dod la sbyar nas 'dod don thob par mdzad pas thabs sla ba phyag rgya bzhi la sogs pa ston pas dka' ba med pa dang / dbang po rnon pos bsgrub par bya ba dang /gzhan gyis byas na ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i las kyis kyang rnam par dag par 'gyur ba bzhis khyad par 'phags la/ de'ang ār+ya de was rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod ces sde snod bzhi par gsungs la/ slob dpon shān+ti pas zab mo'i don bsdus te ston pas na/ mdo sde yin no gsungs/ slob dpon a bh+ya ka ra gup+ta ni/ bslab pa gsum ga ston pas sde snod gsum ga'o zhes bzhed do/ /drug pa bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbye ba la gsum ste/ zhal nas gsungs pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa/ rjes su gnang ba'i bka'o/ /dang po ni/ 'phags pa sdud pa lta bu'o/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 73gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa gsum du brgyad stong 'grel par bshad do/ /dang po ni/ sa bcu pa'i mdo lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba'i mdo lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa ston pa'i mdo lta bu'o/ /mkhas pa (khri lo/'ga' zhig thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa la gsum du 'byed de/ thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang / thugs thugs rjes byin gyis brlabs pa dang /thugs bden pa'i stobs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /dang po ni shes rab snying po lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni gnod sbyin la sogs pas smras pa'i sngags sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs kyis nam mkha' dang 'od zer dang rol mo las chos kyi sgra byung ba lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gleng gzhi dang mtshams sbyor dang mthun sbyor yi rangs rnams te/chos yang dag par sdud pa las/ dge slong dag 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes gyis la chos bsdu bar bya'o zhes dang / 'brel ba dang go rim yang bstan par bya'o zhes rjes su gnang ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bstan bcos ni/ mtshan nyid/ nges tshig dbye ba gsum gyis nges par bya ba las/dang po ni/ rtsom pa po rnam g.yeng med pa'i yid can gyis bka'i don bshad cing thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes su mthun pa ste/ rgyud bla mar/gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 73gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa gsum du brgyad stong 'grel par bshad do/ /dang po ni/ sa bcu pa'i mdo lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba'i mdo lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa ston pa'i mdo lta bu'o/ /mkhas pa (khri lo/'ga' zhig thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa la gsum du 'byed de/ thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang / thugs thugs rjes byin gyis brlabs pa dang /thugs bden pa'i stobs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /dang po ni shes rab snying po lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni gnod sbyin la sogs pas smras pa'i sngags sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs kyis nam mkha' dang 'od zer dang rol mo las chos kyi sgra byung ba lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gleng gzhi dang mtshams sbyor dang mthun sbyor yi rangs rnams te/chos yang dag par sdud pa las/ dge slong dag 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes gyis la chos bsdu bar bya'o zhes dang / 'brel ba dang go rim yang bstan par bya'o zhes rjes su gnang ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bstan bcos ni/ mtshan nyid/ nges tshig dbye ba gsum gyis nges par bya ba las/dang po ni/ rtsom pa po rnam g.yeng med pa'i yid can gyis bka'i don bshad cing thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes su mthun pa ste/ rgyud bla mar/gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad/ /

74 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa/ /de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blang / /zhes dres/ /gnyis pa ni/ saṃ skṛ ta las shā s+t+ra zhes pa'i shā sa na zhes pa 'chos pa ste/ rgyu nyon mongs pa dug gsum las bslab pa gsum ldan du 'chos pa dang / tā yi zhes pa'am ta ra ṇa zhes pa skyob pa ste/ 'bras bu ngan 'gro dang srid pa'i sdug bsngal las skyob pa ste/ nges tshig 'di bka' la'ang gnas so/ /rnam bshad rigs par/sangs rgyas kyi gsung bstan bcos kyi mtshan nyid du 'thad pa'i phyir ro/ /nges pa'i tshig du ma 'chos pa dang skyob par byed pas de'i phyir bstan bcos so/ /nyon mongs dgra rnams ma lus 'chos pa dang / /ngan 'gro srid las skyob pa gang yin pa/ /'chos skyob yon tan phyir na bstan bcos te/ /gnyis po 'di dag gzhan gyi lugs la med/ /de lta bas na sangs rgyas kyi gsung kho na don dam par bstan bcos yin pas 'chos pa dang skyob pa'i yon tan gyi phyir yang don gzung ba la 'bad pa dang ldan par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa la/ mchog dman gyi sgo nas dang / byed pa las kyi sgo nas dang /brjod bya don gyi sgo nas dang / bshad bya bka'i sgo nas dbye ba/ bstan bcos kyi rigs bsdu ba dang lnga'o/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 75dang po ni/ dgur sa sder gsungs te/ don med pa'i dang / don log pa'i dang / don ldan pa'i bstan bcos te gsum dang / ngan g.yo'i dang / snying brtse med pa'i dang / sdug bsngal spong ba'i bstan bcos te gsum dang / thos pa lhur len pa'i dang / rtsod pa lhur len pa'i dang / sgrub pa lhur len pa'i bstan bcos gsum ste/ dgu las phyi ma re re mchog yin la snga ma gnyis gnyis dman pa yin no/ /kha cig (snyo skra/thos rtsod lhur len gnyis te lnga mchog tu 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ bsdu ba rnam par gtan la dbab par de gnyis mu stegs kyi bstan bcos su gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na phyi ma re re mchog yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi bkar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ bka' rgya chen po sdud pa dang / zab mo rnam par 'byed pa dang / zhabrugs pa sdeb pa'i bstan bcos gsum mo/ /dang po 'dul ba'i mdo lta bu/ gnyis pa mngon rtogs rgyan lta bu/ gsum pa mdo sde rgyan nam bslab btus lta bu'o/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ shes bya ji snyed pa ston pa dang / ji lta ba ston pa dang /thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa dang gsum mo/ /dang po la phal pa dang /khyad par can gnyis las/dang po ni/ 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos dang / brtag pa bco brgyad la sogs pa ste/ shes rab brgya pa dang skye bo gso thigs dang tshigs su bcad pa'i mdzod la sogs pa ste/ de dag kyang mngon mtho'i rgyu yin zhing thar pa'i rten du 'gro srid de/

76 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring / /lha dang mi yi them skas la/ /'dzeg na thar pa gam na 'dug /ces shes rab brgya par 'byung bas so/ /de'i phyogs mthun/ mi brtag pa rta brtag pa glang po brtag pa la sogs pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gtso bo rig pa'i gnas kyi bstan bcos te/ mdo sde rgyan nas/rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes gzung dang / /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed/ /ces pas gzhan tshar gcod pa gtan tshigs rig pa dang sgra rig pa gnyis/ rjes su 'dzin pa gso ba rig pa dang bzo rig pa gnyis/ bdag nyid kun shes par byed pa nang rig pa'o/ /gtan tshigs rig pa la/ mngon sum/ rang don rjes dpag gzhan sel/ dpe/ltag chod brtag pa ste/ drug tu bsdus nas ston pa tshad ma'i mdo lta bu'am/ de'i dgongs 'grel rab tu byed pa sde bdun lta bu'am/ brtag pa sde bdun nam grub pa sde brgyad dam rjes 'brang bdun la sogs pa'o/ /rab tu byed pa sde bdun ni/ gtso bo lus lta bu'i bstan bcos gsum dang /

76 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring / /lha dang mi yi them skas la/ /'dzeg na thar pa gam na 'dug /ces shes rab brgya par 'byung bas so/ /de'i phyogs mthun/ mi brtag pa rta brtag pa glang po brtag pa la sogs pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gtso bo rig pa'i gnas kyi bstan bcos te/ mdo sde rgyan nas/rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes gzung dang / /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed/ /ces pas gzhan tshar gcod pa gtan tshigs rig pa dang sgra rig pa gnyis/ rjes su 'dzin pa gso ba rig pa dang bzo rig pa gnyis/ bdag nyid kun shes par byed pa nang rig pa'o/ /gtan tshigs rig pa la/ mngon sum/ rang don rjes dpag gzhan sel/ dpe/ltag chod brtag pa ste/ drug tu bsdus nas ston pa tshad ma'i mdo lta bu'am/ de'i dgongs 'grel rab tu byed pa sde bdun lta bu'am/ brtag pa sde bdun nam grub pa sde brgyad dam rjes 'brang bdun la sogs pa'o/ /rab tu byed pa sde bdun ni/ gtso bo lus lta bu'i bstan bcos gsum dang /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 77gyes pa yan lag dang 'dra ba'i bstan bcos bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ dbang po rno 'bring rtul gsum gyis yang dag pa'i shes pa bde blag tu rtogs pa 'i thabs ston pa rigs thigs rnam nges rnam 'grel gsum mo/ /kha che dz+nyā na shrī rnam nges tshad ma'i mdo'i dgongs 'grel du mi 'dod kyang / de yi lugs ni gsal bar bya/ /zhes 'byung zhing / slob dpon chos mchog gis mdo'i dgongs 'grel du mdzad pa nyid 'thad do/ /yan lag gi bstan bcos bzhi ni/ mngon sum le'u las 'phros pa ni med/rang don rjes dpag las 'phros pa gnyis te/ phyogs chos khyab pa spyir gtan la 'bebs pa gtan tshigs thigs pa dang / rtogs dka' ba khyab pa'am rtags chos kyi 'brel ba gtan la 'bebs pas 'brel ba brtag pa ste gnyis/ gzhan don le'u las 'phros pa rgol phyir rgol rtsod pa dang / rgyal pham tshar gcad kyi gnas ston pa rtsod pa'i rigs pa dang / ngag las gzhan blo rtogs pa tha snyad du sems tsam la'ang mi 'gal bar ston pa/ rang lus blo sngon 'gro ba yi/ /bya ba mthong nas gzhan la de/ /'dzin phyir gal te blo shes 'gyur/ /sems tsam la yang tshul 'di mtshungs/ /zhes ston pa rgyud gzhan grub pa dang bdun no/ /de dag la sogs pa rtog ge'i bstan bcos rnams bod rnams mngon pa'i sde snod du smra ba ni/ mi 'thad de/ rtog ge gtan tshigs rigs pa'i bstan bcos yin la/ mngon pa ni nang rig pa'i

78 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/bstan bcos yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam bshad rigs par/de yi phyir brtag rtog phyir dang / /sngon goms phyir sngon ma byas phyir/ /lung la mi brten nyid phyir dang / /brtson phyir yid la byed phyir dang / /sngon 'phangs phyir dang yongs gzung phyir/ /yongs su bya ba byas pa'i phyir/ /rtog ge phun sum rnam lngar 'dod/ /ces lung la mi brten par bshad pa'i phyir dang / mdo sde rgyan nas/rtog ge rten cing ma nges la/ /ma khyab kun rjenab ḍūrdo ba can/ /byis pa la ni brten par 'dod/ /ces 'byung zhing / mngon pa ni ma mo yin pas de ltar 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /tshad ma kun las btus par yang / tshad ma dang gzhal bya nye bar brjod pa nyid kyis mu stegs pa'i 'dod pa snying po med pa'i phyir der zhen pa rnams ldog pa'i don du 'di brtsams pa yin gyi/ 'di tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la gzhug pa'i don du ni ma yin te/ de'i chos ni rtog ge'i yul ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ldog pa las ni ston pa'i chos nyid thos nas 'bad pa med par rtogs par 'gyur te/ bar du ma bskal ba'i phyir ro zhes bya ba dang / de nyid las/

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 79gang zhig rtog ge'i lam nas chos nyid la 'khrid na/ /thub ba'i bstan las cher bsrings nyams par byas pa yin/ /de lta na'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos mtshan nyid/ /gal te gzhan du 'gro na dpyad par bya ba'i rigs/ /zhes 'do/nga bas rbedu /sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos ni/ rang bzhin dang rkyen dang rnam 'gyur gsum du bsdus nas ston pa la sgra'i mdo yan lag dang bcas pa ste/ rang bzhin ni byings dang ming / rkyen la byings las ming sgrub pa byed ldan gyi rkyen/ ming las ming gzhan sgrub pa de phan gyi rkyen/ de la'ang spyi dang grangs med dang dngos po'i rkyen gsum mo/ /byings las tshig sgrub cing dus rnam par 'byed pa ting nge dang / ming las tshig sgrub cing don rnam par 'byed pa su pra dang / rang bzhin dang rkyen gyi bar du gzhug pa ā ga ma dang / byings gzhan du sgyur ba'i nyer sgyur rnams so/ /nyer sgyur ni rang bzhin du rigs so/ /rnam 'gyur ni mtshams sbyor la sogs pa'i dbang gis yi ge dbyi ba dang bsgyur ba la sogs dang tshig gi bsdu ba rnams so/ /de dag gis sgra'i brjod bya bsdus pa'am/ yang na mtshams sbyor dang ming dang kun bshad pa dang kṛ tra dang bzhis mdo'i don rtsa ba bstan la/ byings nyer sgyur u ṇa la sogs pa yan lag ste/ de dag gis 'chad pa ka lwa pa lta bu'am/ yi ge'i tshogs/ ming gi tshogs/tshig gi tshogs gsum du bsdus nas 'chad pa smra sgo lta bu rnams so/ /de dag kyang so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob pa'i rgyur bslab par bya ba'i sde snod gsum gang yang min no/ /de dag dang 'brel ba yi ge lci yang gi bye brag gi sbyor tshul dang

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 79gang zhig rtog ge'i lam nas chos nyid la 'khrid na/ /thub ba'i bstan las cher bsrings nyams par byas pa yin/ /de lta na'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos mtshan nyid/ /gal te gzhan du 'gro na dpyad par bya ba'i rigs/ /zhes 'do/nga bas rbedu /sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos ni/ rang bzhin dang rkyen dang rnam 'gyur gsum du bsdus nas ston pa la sgra'i mdo yan lag dang bcas pa ste/ rang bzhin ni byings dang ming / rkyen la byings las ming sgrub pa byed ldan gyi rkyen/ ming las ming gzhan sgrub pa de phan gyi rkyen/ de la'ang spyi dang grangs med dang dngos po'i rkyen gsum mo/ /byings las tshig sgrub cing dus rnam par 'byed pa ting nge dang / ming las tshig sgrub cing don rnam par 'byed pa su pra dang / rang bzhin dang rkyen gyi bar du gzhug pa ā ga ma dang / byings gzhan du sgyur ba'i nyer sgyur rnams so/ /nyer sgyur ni rang bzhin du rigs so/ /rnam 'gyur ni mtshams sbyor la sogs pa'i dbang gis yi ge dbyi ba dang bsgyur ba la sogs dang tshig gi bsdu ba rnams so/ /de dag gis sgra'i brjod bya bsdus pa'am/ yang na mtshams sbyor dang ming dang kun bshad pa dang kṛ tra dang bzhis mdo'i don rtsa ba bstan la/ byings nyer sgyur u ṇa la sogs pa yan lag ste/ de dag gis 'chad pa ka lwa pa lta bu'am/ yi ge'i tshogs/ ming gi tshogs/tshig gi tshogs gsum du bsdus nas 'chad pa smra sgo lta bu rnams so/ /de dag kyang so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob pa'i rgyur bslab par bya ba'i sde snod gsum gang yang min no/ /de dag dang 'brel ba yi ge lci yang gi bye brag gi sbyor tshul dang

80 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/prastu ra dgod pa ston pa sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos rin chen 'byung gnas lta bu dang / ming gi rnam grangs dang rtags gsum gyi dbye ba dang ming gcig don mang po la 'jug pa'i tshul la sogs pa ston pa mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos 'chi med mdzod lta bu dang / snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos la snyan dngags kyi mtshan nyid dang snyan dngags kyi grub mtha' 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba'i tshul dang rgyan sum cu rtsa lnga dang bya dka' dang gab tshig la sogs pa ston pa me long lta bu'am/ de sbyar nas ston pa zlos gar la sogs pa'o/ /snyan dngags la sogs pa 'di dag sgra'i yan lag gam/ yang na rig byed kyi yan lag ste/ 'chi med mdzod las/ snyan dngags nges brjod mchod sbyin te/ /'di gsum rig byed gsum pa yin/ /zhes so/ /gso ba rig pa'i bstan bcos ni/ nad dang / nad kyi gzhi dang / nad kyi gnyen po sman dang / des gso ba'i spyod lam dang bzhi ston pa'am/ yang na/lus dang byis pa gdon lus stod/ /mtshon dang mche ba rgas ro rtsa/ /gso dpyad gang la gnas pa yi/ /yan lag brgyad du de bshad do/ /zhes pas/ sbrum ma dang bu chung dang de'i gdon nad dang lus te byang khog gam 'du ba dang stod de mgo bo dang mtshon gyis rmas pa dang mche bas rmas pa dang dpyad dang brgyad du bsdus nas ston pa yan lag brgyad pa lta bu'o/ /bzo rig pa'i bstan bcos ni gser 'gyur dang / sku gzugs kyi tshad la sogs pa'i bstan bcos so/ /

80 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/prastu ra dgod pa ston pa sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos rin chen 'byung gnas lta bu dang / ming gi rnam grangs dang rtags gsum gyi dbye ba dang ming gcig don mang po la 'jug pa'i tshul la sogs pa ston pa mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos 'chi med mdzod lta bu dang / snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos la snyan dngags kyi mtshan nyid dang snyan dngags kyi grub mtha' 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba'i tshul dang rgyan sum cu rtsa lnga dang bya dka' dang gab tshig la sogs pa ston pa me long lta bu'am/ de sbyar nas ston pa zlos gar la sogs pa'o/ /snyan dngags la sogs pa 'di dag sgra'i yan lag gam/ yang na rig byed kyi yan lag ste/ 'chi med mdzod las/ snyan dngags nges brjod mchod sbyin te/ /'di gsum rig byed gsum pa yin/ /zhes so/ /gso ba rig pa'i bstan bcos ni/ nad dang / nad kyi gzhi dang / nad kyi gnyen po sman dang / des gso ba'i spyod lam dang bzhi ston pa'am/ yang na/lus dang byis pa gdon lus stod/ /mtshon dang mche ba rgas ro rtsa/ /gso dpyad gang la gnas pa yi/ /yan lag brgyad du de bshad do/ /zhes pas/ sbrum ma dang bu chung dang de'i gdon nad dang lus te byang khog gam 'du ba dang stod de mgo bo dang mtshon gyis rmas pa dang mche bas rmas pa dang dpyad dang brgyad du bsdus nas ston pa yan lag brgyad pa lta bu'o/ /bzo rig pa'i bstan bcos ni gser 'gyur dang / sku gzugs kyi tshad la sogs pa'i bstan bcos so/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 81nang rig pa'i yang phung po dang khams dang skye mched dam/ de'i dbye ba'am bye brag ston pa rnams ji snyed pa ston pa ste/ mngon pa kun btus sam mtshan nyid kun las btus lta buce(/ /gnyis pa ji lta ba ston pa ni/ bden pa bzhi rnam pa bcu drug tu ston pa'am/gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi don ston pa dang / rang bzhin med pa'i don ston pa bden pa rnam nges sam sum cu pa'am dbu ma rgyan lta bu'o / /gsum pa thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam ston pa ni/ byang sa nyan sa'am spyod 'jug la sogs pa'o/ /kha cig na re/ de dag re re tsam ston pa rab tu byed pa yin la/ ma lus par ston pa bstan bcos chen po ste/ kun las btus sam mdzod lta bu'o zer ro/ /bzhi pa la/ bka' spyi dang / bye brag gi dgongs 'grel lo/ /dang po ni/ bka' spyi'i tshig gi cha gsal bar byed pa brda sprod pa sgra'i bstan bcos sam/ don gyi cha gsal bar byed pa tarka rigs pa'i bstan bcos gnyis so zhes gsungs so/ /kho bo ni gzhan du sems so/ /gnyis pa bye brag gi dgongs 'grel la gsum/ bka' dang po'i dgongs 'grel la/ lta ba'i cha gsal bar byed pa dang / spyod pa'i cha gsal bar byed pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ mngon pa sde bdun te/ ji skad du/chos kyi phung po shā ri'i bus/ /gdags pa'i bstan bcos mong gal bus/ /

82 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/khams kyi tshogs ni gang pos byas/ /rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyid kyis/ /ye shes la 'jug ka t+ya'i bus/ /rab tu byed pa dbyig bshes kyis/ /yang dag 'gro ba'i rnam grangs ni/ /gsus po che yis byas zhes grags/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /kha che bye brag tu smra ba na re/ bdun po 'di bka' yin te/ ston pas yul dus gang zag tha dad la thor bur gsungs pa rnams nyan tho sa dgra bcom pas bsdus pa yin te/ dper na ched du brjod pa'i tshoms bzhin no/ /de lta min na bka' la sde snod gsum ma tshang bar 'gyur ro zer ro/ /mdo sde pa la sogs pa na re/ ma mo ni/ mdo sde 'dul ba gnyis ka'i spyi khyab bam gseb tshang nas bstan pas skyon med la bdun po bstan bcos su 'dod do/ /bdun po de'i don bsdus pa bye brag tu bshad pa chen po/ de'i don bsdus pa mngon pa mdzod la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lung gzhi bcu bdun gyi rab byung gi gzhi dang por bstan/ de nas rnam 'byed gnyis dang gzhi bcu drug bstan pa gzhir byas pa la gzhung dam pa'i zhu ba 'dul byed la sogs pa dang / phran tshegs kyi skabs nas 'byung ba rnams ji ltar rigs par sbyar nas 'chad pa mdo rtsa dang / rnam 'byed gzhir byas nas gzhan ji ltar rigs par sbyar nas 'chad pa me tog phreng rgyud dam sum brgya pa lta bu'o/ /

82 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/khams kyi tshogs ni gang pos byas/ /rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyid kyis/ /ye shes la 'jug ka t+ya'i bus/ /rab tu byed pa dbyig bshes kyis/ /yang dag 'gro ba'i rnam grangs ni/ /gsus po che yis byas zhes grags/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /kha che bye brag tu smra ba na re/ bdun po 'di bka' yin te/ ston pas yul dus gang zag tha dad la thor bur gsungs pa rnams nyan tho sa dgra bcom pas bsdus pa yin te/ dper na ched du brjod pa'i tshoms bzhin no/ /de lta min na bka' la sde snod gsum ma tshang bar 'gyur ro zer ro/ /mdo sde pa la sogs pa na re/ ma mo ni/ mdo sde 'dul ba gnyis ka'i spyi khyab bam gseb tshang nas bstan pas skyon med la bdun po bstan bcos su 'dod do/ /bdun po de'i don bsdus pa bye brag tu bshad pa chen po/ de'i don bsdus pa mngon pa mdzod la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lung gzhi bcu bdun gyi rab byung gi gzhi dang por bstan/ de nas rnam 'byed gnyis dang gzhi bcu drug bstan pa gzhir byas pa la gzhung dam pa'i zhu ba 'dul byed la sogs pa dang / phran tshegs kyi skabs nas 'byung ba rnams ji ltar rigs par sbyar nas 'chad pa mdo rtsa dang / rnam 'byed gzhir byas nas gzhan ji ltar rigs par sbyar nas 'chad pa me tog phreng rgyud dam sum brgya pa lta bu'o/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 83gnyis pa bka' bar ma'i dgongs 'grel la/ lta ba'i cha dang / spyod pa'i cha gsal bar byed pa gnyis so / /dang po la/ shing rta'i srol 'byed bzhir grags te/ mdos dngos su brjod pa'i don nam/ snying po'i don ston pa dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs drug ste/ chos thams cad rang bzhin stong pa nyid rten 'brel spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bar ston pa stong nyid bdun cu pa/ de las gzhan skye ba la sogs par bden pa 'gog pa rtsa ba shes rab ste/ gnyis po rtsa ba'am gtso bo'o/ /de rigs pas sgrub pa rigs pa drug cu pa/de la gzhan gyis rtsod pa'i skyon sprong ba rtsod pa bzlog pa/ gzhan rtog ge ba dang rtsod pa'i tshul ston pa zhib mo rnam 'thag don dam par rang bzhin med kyang kun rdzob tu 'jig rten gyi tha snyad 'thad cing grub par ston pa tha snyad grub pa dang drug yin no zhes gsungs so/ khugs la bstan pa'i don nam mngon par rtogs pa'i don gtso bor ston pa mngon rtogs rgyan te/ rnam mkhyen lam shes gzhi shes te/'jug yul mkhyen gsum/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs dang rtse mo dang mthar gyis pa dang skad cig ma ste/ 'jug pa sbyor ba bzhi/ zhugs 'bras chos kyi sku ste/ brgyad du 'dus par ston7pa'o/ /de dag gtso bo'i don sum cu rtsa gnyis su ston pa brgyad stong don bsdus te/ de nyid las/rten dang dbang du bya ba dang / /las dang sgom pa dang bcas dang / /rab dbye rtags dang lhung ba dang / /phan yon bcas par yang dag brjod/ /

84 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/ces pas/ rten ston pa sangs rgyas dang / dbang du bya ba 'khor dang / las yum la chos spyod bcus ji ltar spyod pa dang / sgom pa la/ dngos med dngos po/ sgro 'dogs skur 'debs/ gcig dang tha dad/ ngo bo dang khyad par/ ming ji lta ba bzhin du don dang don ji lta ba bzhin du ming du rtog pa ste/ rnam g.yeng bcu'i gnyen por sgom pa bcu dang / nang stong pa nyid nas dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar rab tu dbye ba stong nyid bcu drug dang / rtags la bdud las kyi rtags dang phyir mi ldog gi rtags gnyis dang / sher phyin spangs na rnam smin ngan song du ltung ba dang / stong gsum la sogs pa rin po ches bkang nas sbyin pa byas pa bas sher phyin la spyad na bsod nams che ba la sogs pa'i phan yon dang po gnyis kyis thams cad bsdus shing de nyid dgos pa'i dbang gis bzlas te bshad par 'dod do/ /sgo gsum rnam grangs bcu gcig tu ston pa 'bum ṭīka ste/ de la rgyal ba'i yum thog mar gleng gzhis skabs phye nas 'dul bya dbang po rnon po la/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rjethogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson par bya'o/ /zhes pa gang zag gang gis gang gi phyir du gang la ji ltar bslab tshul dang bzhis don thams cad bsdus te bstan pa'i sgo/ de nas skabs dang po'i bar la 'bring du bstan pa'i sgo/ de nas mjug rdzogs kyi bar la rgyas par bstan pa'i sgo ste gsum mo/ /rnam grangs bcu gcig ni/ dang po shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa dang / de nas rab 'byor gyis bshad pa gcig dang / de nas brgya byin la bka' stsal pa gnyis dang / rab kutswa1ra la bka' stsal pa bzhi dang / byams pa la bka' stsal pa gnyis

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 85dang / kun dga' bo la bka' stsal nas yongs su gtad pa ste bcu gcig go /'di rda ṣ+ṭa se nas byas zer yang dbyig gnyen gyi gzhung 'grel du rigs shing / 'di dang brgyad stong don bsdus gnyis kyis sems tsam du bstan no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bslab btus sam mdo btus sam/ lta spyod zung 'brel du ston pa spyod 'jug gam sgom rim rnam gsum la sogs pa'o/ /gsum pa bka' mtha' ma'i dgongs 'grel la/ lta ba dang spyod pa'i cha gsal byed gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ 'phags pa byams pas mdzad pa mdo sde rgyan/ dbus dang mtha' rnam 'byed/ chos dang chos nyid rnam 'a byed/ rgyud bla ma ste/ bzhi'i dang po gnyis mngon pa'i sde snod/ mtha' ma gnyis mdo sde'i sde snod/ mngon rtogs rgyan 'dul ba'i sde snod ces kha cig 'chad kyang shes byed ma mthong ngo / /mdo sde rgyan ni theg pa chen po'i chos thams cad don lngar bsdus te ston pa yin no/ /gser las brdungs byas 'dra zhing pad+ma rgyas pa bzhin/ /bkres pas nyen pa gaskuskos legs kha zas za ba 'dra/ /'phrin yig legs par thos 'dra rin chen sgrom phye ltar/ /chos de 'dir bshad pas kyang dga' ba'i mchog skyed do/ /zhes pa'i don bstan no/ /dbus dang mtha' rnam 'byed ni/ mtha 'a zhes pa yod med dam rtag chad gnyis kyi lta ba/ dbus zhes pa de gnyis spangs pa dbu ma'i lam/ de dag rnam par 'byed pas na dbus mtha' rnam 'byed ces bya la/ de yang /mtshan nyid sgrib pa de kho na/ /gnyen po dang ni sgom pa dang / /de yi gnas dang 'bras bu thob/ /theg pa bla na med pa yin/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 85dang / kun dga' bo la bka' stsal nas yongs su gtad pa ste bcu gcig go /'di rda ṣ+ṭa se nas byas zer yang dbyig gnyen gyi gzhung 'grel du rigs shing / 'di dang brgyad stong don bsdus gnyis kyis sems tsam du bstan no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bslab btus sam mdo btus sam/ lta spyod zung 'brel du ston pa spyod 'jug gam sgom rim rnam gsum la sogs pa'o/ /gsum pa bka' mtha' ma'i dgongs 'grel la/ lta ba dang spyod pa'i cha gsal byed gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ 'phags pa byams pas mdzad pa mdo sde rgyan/ dbus dang mtha' rnam 'byed/ chos dang chos nyid rnam 'a byed/ rgyud bla ma ste/ bzhi'i dang po gnyis mngon pa'i sde snod/ mtha' ma gnyis mdo sde'i sde snod/ mngon rtogs rgyan 'dul ba'i sde snod ces kha cig 'chad kyang shes byed ma mthong ngo / /mdo sde rgyan ni theg pa chen po'i chos thams cad don lngar bsdus te ston pa yin no/ /gser las brdungs byas 'dra zhing pad+ma rgyas pa bzhin/ /bkres pas nyen pa gaskuskos legs kha zas za ba 'dra/ /'phrin yig legs par thos 'dra rin chen sgrom phye ltar/ /chos de 'dir bshad pas kyang dga' ba'i mchog skyed do/ /zhes pa'i don bstan no/ /dbus dang mtha' rnam 'byed ni/ mtha 'a zhes pa yod med dam rtag chad gnyis kyi lta ba/ dbus zhes pa de gnyis spangs pa dbu ma'i lam/ de dag rnam par 'byed pas na dbus mtha' rnam 'byed ces bya la/ de yang /mtshan nyid sgrib pa de kho na/ /gnyen po dang ni sgom pa dang / /de yi gnas dang 'bras bu thob/ /theg pa bla na med pa yin/ /

86 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/zhes don bdun gyis bstan pa yin no/ /chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed ni/ chos zhes pa kun nas nyon mongs pa 'khor ba'i chos so/ /chos nyid mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos de gnyis kyi rnam par dbye ba ston pas chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed ces bya'o/ /rgyud bla ma ni/ theg pa chen po'i rgyud dam rgyun chags pa'i chos rnams kyi bla ma ste/ chos rnams kyi gong mar gyur pas de skad ces bya'o/ /yang na ut+ta ra ni phyi ma ste/ theg pa chen po'i rgyud phyi ma'i dgongs pa 'grel bas de skad ces bya zhing / de yang dkon mchog gsum dang de'i khams dang 'bras bu byang chub dang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi dang 'phrin las te bdun ston pa ste/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams dang byang chub dang / /skuston tan sangs rgyas 'phrin las mtha' ma ste/ /bstan bcos kun gyi lus ni mdor bsdu na/ /rdo rje yi ni gnas bdun 'di dag go /zhes so/ /de'i steng du mngon rtogs rgyan bsnan pa la byams pa'i chos lnga'o/ /de'i rjes su 'brangs pa 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i rgyas pa'i bstan bcos sa sde lnga dang / bsdus pa'i bstan bcos sdom rnam pa gnyis dang /dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad la sogs pa'o/ /de la sa sde lnga ni rtsa ba lta bu/ sa'i dngos gzhi ni sa bcu bdun du bsdus nas ston pa/ de nyid las/ sdom ni/rnam shes lnga dang ldan pa'i sa/ /yid kyi sa dang gzhan gsum ste/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 87rtog dpyod bcas la sogs pa dang / /ting 'dzin bcas dang ma yin dang / /sems yod pa dang sems med dang / /thos dang bsam dang sgom ldan dang / /de bzhin theg pa gsum ldan dang / /phung por bcas dang phung med gzhan/ /zhes so/ /bcu bdun po de yang rten dang spyod pa dang 'bras bu gsum gyi dbang du mdzad nas bstan la/ de la'ang gsum ste/ rnam shes lnga ldan gyi sa dang yid kyi sa ga/nyis rten gyi rang bzhin no/ /rtog bcas dpyod bcas dang / rtog med dpyod bcas dang / rtog med dpyod med kyi sa ste/ gsum rten gyi 'jug tshul lo/ /mnyam par bzhag ma bzhag dang / sems yod med kyi sa ste bzhi rten gyi skabs so/ /spyod pa'i dbang du byas pa thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sa gsum mo/ /'bras bu la gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu nyan sa byang sa rang sa gsum/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu phung po lhag bcas lhag med do/ /de'i 'grel pa lta bu rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba ste/ sa'i dngos gzhi'i tshig don gnyis ka mu bzhi la sogs par gtan la dbab par bstan la/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa ma gtogs pa la bsdu ba gtan la dbab pa yod do/ /de gnyis kyis gsung rab rnams kyi don bstan no/ /gzhi bsdu ba ni/ sngar gyi gzhung de dag sde snod gsum du sdud tshul te/ 'di'i mdor bstan du sde snod gsum ga bsdu ba smos nas rgyas bshad du mdo sde dang 'dul ba bsdu ba gnyis las ma bshad pa ni ma mo bsdu ba sa sde lnga po nyid yin pas logs

88 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/su ma bshad de/ thos pa'i sa gtan la dbab pa bsdu bar/ de la ma mo bsdu ba ni sa bcu bdun dang bsdu ba bzhi'o zhes 'byung bas so/ /rnam grangs bsdu ba ni/ rjod byed ming gi rnam grangs bstan pa'am kun nas nyon mongs dang rnam byang gi rnam grangs bye brag tu 'chad pa'o/ /de gnyis gzhung ngo / /rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bsdu/ ba ni/ de dag bshad tshul ston pa ste/ de ltar gsung rab kyi don dang gzhung dang bshad tshul gyi dbang gis sa sde lnga'o/ /sdom rnam pa gnyis kyi theg pa thun mong gi sdom mngon pa kun las btus ni mtshan nyid kun las btus pa dang / bden pa rnam nges/ chos rnam nges/ thob pa rnam nges/ 'bel gtam rnam nges te lngar bsdus nas ston pa'o/ /theg pa chen po'i sdom theg chen bsdus pa ni shes bya'i gnas la sogs pa don bcus theg chen bsdus nas ston pa'o/ /dbyig gnyen gyi rab tu byed pa sde brgyad ni/ chos thams cad sems tsam du ston pa sum cu pa/ de rigs pas sgrub pa nyi shu pa/ de'i gzhi phung po lnga 'thad par ston pa phung po lnga pa/ de ltar yin yang bshad nyan 'thad par ston pa rnam bshad rigs pa/sgo gsum gyi las 'thad par ston pa las grub pa'i rab tu byed pa ste rang rgyud du brtsams pa lnga/ phyin drug sogs spyod pa rgya chen dang / rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang /mtshan nyid gsum 'thad par ston pa mdo sde rgyan/ rten 'brel gyi mdo/ dbus dang mtha' rnam 'byed gsum gyi 'grel pa ste/ gzhan 'grel du brtsams pa gsum ste brgyad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /kha cig slob dpon 'dis sa bcu pa'i 'grel pa la sogs pa mang du mdzad pas sde brgyad nges pa med cing byams pa dang 'brel ba'i chos nyi shu'i grangs nges med zer ro/ /grangs nges mdzad pa rnams ni/ sa sde lnga sdom gnyis byams chos lnga rab tu byed pa sde brgyad de/ de dag la 'dod do/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 89gnyis pa ni/ sdom pa nyi shu pa la sogs pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ bstan bcos kyi rigs bsdu na/ bka 'a la mi brten pa dang / brten pa gnyis/ brten pa la/ bka' nyid la 'grel pa btab pa dang / bka'i don rang rgyud du brtsams pa gnyis/ dang po la'ang tshig don gnyis ka rgya cher 'grel pa so sor thar pa'i 'grel pa bam po lnga bcu pa lta bu rgya cher 'grel/ tshig gi cha spros pa dang bcas nas 'chad pa ched du brjod pa'i tshoms kyi 'grel pa lta bu tshig gi 'grel ba/ go dka' ba'i don rnam par 'byed pa sdud 'grel gnyis lta bu dka' 'grel/ don gyi gtso bo bsdus nas ston pa sdud pa'i don bsdus dri me da bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa lta bu bsdus don gyi 'grel pa/ ngag gi don dril nas ston pa ngag don tsam gyi 'grel pa ste lnga'o/ /gnyis pa la/ bka' gcig gi don rdzogs par ston pa dang / thor bur ston pa dang / bka' mang po'i don ston pa gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan nam mdo rtsa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dge tshul gyi kā ri kā lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bslab btus sam bshes springs la sogs pa'o/ /spyir 'grel pa la/ 'grel pa dang bshad pa dang rnam par bshad pa dang bshad sbyar dang / don bsdus dang / dka' 'grel dang rgya cher 'grel dang legs par sbyar ba dang / rnam par phye ba la sogs pa ming mang po 'byung ngo / /de ltar bstan bcos kyi dbye ba ni/ blo gros 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir bstan bcos tsam gyi dbye ba yin la/ sngar gyi mtshan nyid dang nges tshig ni/ bstan bcos khyad par can gyi yin pas 'gal bar mi bsam mo/ /spyi don gsum pa (nyin bshad tshul ji ltar sgrub cing nyams su blang tswa)la bzhi ste/ bshad bya chos kyi khyad par/ slob dpon gyis 'chad tshul gyi khyad par/ slob

90 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/mas mnyan tshul gyi khyad par/ gnyis kas chos kyi don sgrub par gdams pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir shes bya la mkhas par bya ba'i phyir bstan bcos sna tshogs la bslab dgos te/ 'dul ba las kyang phyi rol pa'i bstan bcos la sogs pa'ang bslab par gsungs shing / byang sems kyis ni khyad par du thams cad la bslab par gsungs so/ /'on kyang gtso bo lam du 'gro ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bshad nyan byed dgos la/ bstan pa'i ngos 'dzin ni/ 'od ldan nas/bslab pa gsum ni rab ston cing / /phyag rgya gsum dang yang dag ldan/ /thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba/ /sangs rgyas gsung du mkhas pas rtogs/ /zhes bsgrub bya bslab pa gsum/ lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya gsum ste/ chos thams cad bdag med/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag zag bcas kyi 'du byed thams cad sdu/ga bsngal ba ste gsum ston cing ngo bo thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba la bshad do/ /so so thar par/sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mdo las/ dam pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/

90 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/mas mnyan tshul gyi khyad par/ gnyis kas chos kyi don sgrub par gdams pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir shes bya la mkhas par bya ba'i phyir bstan bcos sna tshogs la bslab dgos te/ 'dul ba las kyang phyi rol pa'i bstan bcos la sogs pa'ang bslab par gsungs shing / byang sems kyis ni khyad par du thams cad la bslab par gsungs so/ /'on kyang gtso bo lam du 'gro ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bshad nyan byed dgos la/ bstan pa'i ngos 'dzin ni/ 'od ldan nas/bslab pa gsum ni rab ston cing / /phyag rgya gsum dang yang dag ldan/ /thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba/ /sangs rgyas gsung du mkhas pas rtogs/ /zhes bsgrub bya bslab pa gsum/ lta ba bkar btags kyi phyag rgya gsum ste/ chos thams cad bdag med/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag zag bcas kyi 'du byed thams cad sdu/ga bsngal ba ste gsum ston cing ngo bo thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba la bshad do/ /so so thar par/sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mdo las/ dam pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 91mtha' mar dge ba/ don bzang po tshig 'bru bzang po ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa yongs su dag pa yongs su byang ba zhes gsungs shing thog mtha 'a bar gsum du dge ba ni thogs med la sogs pas thos bsam sgom gsum la bshad/ kha cig mdo'i mgor gleng gzhi/ bar du mdo dngos/ mthar mthun 'gyur yi rang ste gsum la 'chad/ slob dpon dge ba'i lhas bstan bcos kyi thog mar mchod brjod/bar du bstan bcos kyi lus/ mtha' mar bsngo ba gsum la bshad do/ /'dir rnam bshad rigs pa ltar bshad na/ thog ma dang bar dang mtha' ma ni tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab kyi phung po yongs su nyams pa med pas dge ba'o/ /don bzang po ni phyin ci ma log pa'i brjod par bya ba phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /tshig 'bru bzang po ni go bar byed pas rjod par byed pa phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /ma 'dres pa ni gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /yongs su rdzogs pa ni nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi gnyen po'i phyir ro/ /yongs su dag pa ni rang gi sa pa'i nyon mongs pa las rnam par grol bas ngo bo nyid rnam par grol ba'o/ /yongs su byang ba ni sa gzhan gyi nyon mongs kyi bag la nyal spangs pas rgyud rnam par grol ba'o/ /de dag dang ldan pa ni dam pa'i chos su rtogs par bya'o/ /mdor na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dam pa'i chos ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i mdo sde la 'jug nyon mongs pa 'dul ba la snang / rten 'brel gyi chos nyid dang mi 'gal ba zhig yin pa theg pa thun mong ba'i lugs yin zhing / theg chen gyi lugs kyis rgyud bla mar sngar bshad pa bzhin nam/ mnges sde rgyan las/dad dang dga' dang blo rnams kyi/ /rgyu phyir chos 'di dge ba yin/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 91mtha' mar dge ba/ don bzang po tshig 'bru bzang po ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa yongs su dag pa yongs su byang ba zhes gsungs shing thog mtha 'a bar gsum du dge ba ni thogs med la sogs pas thos bsam sgom gsum la bshad/ kha cig mdo'i mgor gleng gzhi/ bar du mdo dngos/ mthar mthun 'gyur yi rang ste gsum la 'chad/ slob dpon dge ba'i lhas bstan bcos kyi thog mar mchod brjod/bar du bstan bcos kyi lus/ mtha' mar bsngo ba gsum la bshad do/ /'dir rnam bshad rigs pa ltar bshad na/ thog ma dang bar dang mtha' ma ni tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab kyi phung po yongs su nyams pa med pas dge ba'o/ /don bzang po ni phyin ci ma log pa'i brjod par bya ba phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /tshig 'bru bzang po ni go bar byed pas rjod par byed pa phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /ma 'dres pa ni gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /yongs su rdzogs pa ni nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi gnyen po'i phyir ro/ /yongs su dag pa ni rang gi sa pa'i nyon mongs pa las rnam par grol bas ngo bo nyid rnam par grol ba'o/ /yongs su byang ba ni sa gzhan gyi nyon mongs kyi bag la nyal spangs pas rgyud rnam par grol ba'o/ /de dag dang ldan pa ni dam pa'i chos su rtogs par bya'o/ /mdor na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dam pa'i chos ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i mdo sde la 'jug nyon mongs pa 'dul ba la snang / rten 'brel gyi chos nyid dang mi 'gal ba zhig yin pa theg pa thun mong ba'i lugs yin zhing / theg chen gyi lugs kyis rgyud bla mar sngar bshad pa bzhin nam/ mnges sde rgyan las/dad dang dga' dang blo rnams kyi/ /rgyu phyir chos 'di dge ba yin/ /

92 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/don rnam gnyis ldan gzung sla dang / /yon tan bzhi can tshangs spyod ston/ /gzhan dang thun mong ma yin ldan pa dang / /khams gsum nyon mongs rnam spong rdzogs byed dang / /ngo bo nyid dag dri ma dag pa ste/ /tshangs spyod yon tan bzhi ldan yin par 'dod/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /theg chen thun mong min pa'i lugs kyis/ ji skad du/stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /gang la sems ni rab sgom byed/ /de nyid sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge 'dun gyi yang bstan pa'o/ /zhes pas stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can sangs rgyas kyi bstan par bshad do/ /de lta bu'i bstan pa bka' 'am bstan bcos khyad par can de yang tshig dang don gyis gnyis su 'dus te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ji ltar mnam na rab dku la/ /myangs na zhim pa'i sman bzhin du/ /chos kyang de bzhin gnyis su gnas/ /don dang yi ger shes par bya/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 93zhes gsungs so/ /don phun sum tshogs pa tshangs spyod yon tan bzhi ldan la sogs pa'o/ /yi ge phun sum tshogs pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/bstan dang de bzhin bshad pa dang /theg dang mthun dang bde ba dang / /grags pa dang ni ci rigs dang / /nges par 'byung dang mthun pa'i phyir/ /de mdor sems dpa' mchog rnams kyi/ /yi ge phun 31gas yin zhes bya/ /zhes so/ /rnam par bshad pa bsdu ba las kyang mdo sde'i lus ni rnam pa gnyis te tshig 'bru dang don to zhes so/ /de la tshig 'bru ni gnas yin la/ don ni de la gnas pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /de gnyis ka bsdus pa ni shes par bya ba yin no zhes pa dang / chos mchog chung ngur yang rab tu byed pa'i lus ni rnam pa gnyis te sgra dang don to/ /zhes so/ /des na bshad bya'i chos ni sangs rgyas kyis gsungs/sdud pa pos bsdu/ mkha' grub rnams kyis bkral/ lo paṇa skyes mchog rnams kyis bsgyur/ bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag dang lung dang ldan pa'i rgyud sde'am mdo sde bka' 'am bstan bcos mdo sde mngon pa 'dul ba'i sde snod gang yin pa 'di dang 'di 'chad ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gang gis 'chad pa slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ gang la brten nas bshad pa'i thabs/ ji ltar bshad pa'i tshul dang gsum mo / /dang po la gzhung so sor slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba du ma gsungs te/rna/ma btsu) pa 95rngaṭa/

94 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/tshul khrims ldan zhing 'dul ba'i cho ga shes/ /nad par snying brtse 'bor ni dad pa dang / /chos dang zang zing phan 'dogs brtson pa dang / /dus su 'doms pa de ltar bla mar bsngags/ /zhes pa dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag gi /mtshan nyid mdor bsdus mkhyen par mdzod/ /chog shes snying rje tshul khrims ldan/ /nyon mongs sel ba'i shes rab can/ /de dag la ni khyod brten na/ /khyod kyis mkhyen gyi gus par mdzod/ /ces dang / zhi ba lhas/rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /theg chen don la mkhas pa dang / /zhes pa dang / tsan+d+ra go mis/bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas/ /nus dang ldan la blang bar bya/ /

94 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/tshul khrims ldan zhing 'dul ba'i cho ga shes/ /nad par snying brtse 'bor ni dad pa dang / /chos dang zang zing phan 'dogs brtson pa dang / /dus su 'doms pa de ltar bla mar bsngags/ /zhes pa dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag gi /mtshan nyid mdor bsdus mkhyen par mdzod/ /chog shes snying rje tshul khrims ldan/ /nyon mongs sel ba'i shes rab can/ /de dag la ni khyod brten na/ /khyod kyis mkhyen gyi gus par mdzod/ /ces dang / zhi ba lhas/rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /theg chen don la mkhas pa dang / /zhes pa dang / tsan+d+ra go mis/bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas/ /nus dang ldan la blang bar bya/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 95zhes gsungs shing / mdo sde rgyan du/bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan lhag pa brtson bcas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la brten/ / zhes tshul khrims dang ldan pas dul ba dang / ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas zhi ba dang / shes rab dang ldan pas nyon mongs pa nyer zhi dang / yon tan gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pas lhag pa dang / gzhan don la le lo med pas brtson 'grus dang bcas pa dang / thos pa che bas lung gis phyug pa dang / shes par bya ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu rtogs pa dang / tshig smra mkhas pa dang / zang zing la mi blta bas brtse ba dang / chos ston pa la skyo ba med pa ste chos bcu ldan dang /byarme chub sems dpa' thos mang dang / /bden mthong smra mkhas brtse ba can/ /skyo med skyes bu dam pa ni/ /chen po yin par shes par bya/ /zhes lung gi yon tan thos pa mang ba/ rtogs pa'i yon tan bden pa mthong ba/tshig smra mkhas pa/ bsam pa zang zing la mi blta ba'i brtse ba can/ bsam sbyor snyoms las med pas skyo med de chos lnga ldan nam/

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 95zhes gsungs shing / mdo sde rgyan du/bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan lhag pa brtson bcas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la brten/ / zhes tshul khrims dang ldan pas dul ba dang / ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas zhi ba dang / shes rab dang ldan pas nyon mongs pa nyer zhi dang / yon tan gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pas lhag pa dang / gzhan don la le lo med pas brtson 'grus dang bcas pa dang / thos pa che bas lung gis phyug pa dang / shes par bya ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu rtogs pa dang / tshig smra mkhas pa dang / zang zing la mi blta bas brtse ba dang / chos ston pa la skyo ba med pa ste chos bcu ldan dang /byarme chub sems dpa' thos mang dang / /bden mthong smra mkhas brtse ba can/ /skyo med skyes bu dam pa ni/ /chen po yin par shes par bya/ /zhes lung gi yon tan thos pa mang ba/ rtogs pa'i yon tan bden pa mthong ba/tshig smra mkhas pa/ bsam pa zang zing la mi blta ba'i brtse ba can/ bsam sbyor snyoms las med pas skyo med de chos lnga ldan nam/

96 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/rgya che the tshom sbong ba dang / /gzung 'os de nyid gnyis ston pa/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /ston pa phun tshogs yin zhes bya/ /zhes mang du thos pas thos pa rgya che ba/ shes rab che bas gdul bya'i the tshom spong ba/ sgo gsum dge bas bla mar gzung bar 'os pa/ nyon mongs dang rnam byang gi de kho na nyid gnyis ston pa ste chos bzhi ldan la bshad do/ /de dag kyang phal cher 'phags pa'i chos yin pas ldan par dka' yang med ka med kyi yan lag tu dgos pa ni gsum ste/ mkhas pa'i shes rab/ brtse ba'i bsam pa/ sbyor ba bzod pa dang ldan pa gsum mo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ bshad bya la mkhas pa dang / 'chad byed la mkhas pa dang / kun spyod la mkhas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ shes bya'am sde snod kun la mkhas na'ang legs mod kyi/ 'dir gang 'chad pa de'i tshig don la lung rigs man ngag dang ldan pa'i mkhas pa zhig dgos te/ des gdul bya'i the tshom gcod nus pas so /gnyis pa ni/ rjod byed kyi brda dag pa dang / gang nas bshad kyang 'brel/ ji tsam bshad kyang ran/ ji ltar bshad kyang 'thad pa gsum gyi ngag 'brel/ gzhan dga' bar nus pa'i dbyangs snyan pa dang gsum la 'chad do/ /yang na mdo sde rgyan nalngan/ngag tshig shin tu rigs pa dang / /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 97bstan dang rnam 'byed the tshom gcod/ /lan mang byed dang ldan pa ni/ /mgo smos rnam spros go rnams la/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa ni/ /'khor gsum gyis ni dag pa ste/ /'di ni nyes pa brgyad dag dang / /bral ba nyid du shes par bya/ /le lo dang ni mi go dang / /skabs mi 'byed dang ma nges dang / /the tshom dag ni mi gcod dang / / de dang bral bar bstan mi byed/ /skyo ba dang ni ser sna nyid/ /'di dag gtam gyi nyes par 'dod / /de dag med phyir sangs rgyas kyi/ /bshad pa bla na med par 'gyur/ /zhes gtam gyi nyes pa brgyad dang bral bas 'khor gsum dag pa'i bshad pa'am /rnam bshad rigs par brjod pa'i skyon bcu gcig gi gnyen por chos kyi gtam rnam pa nyi shu dang ldan par gsungs te/ spyod lam mi sdug par 'dug pas snod ma yin pa la brjod pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por nyan 'dod pa nyid dang bshad pa'i 'os su gyur pa nyid du shes nas smra ba'i dus su smra ba'o/ /bdag gi bshad nyan 'di lta bu

98 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/la de ma tshang bas snying po med cing lam du 'gro bar ma mthong ngo / /brjod pa yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por brnyas pa med pas bsgrims pas smra ba'o/ /brjod pa bar chad pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por gsum ste go rim du smra ba ste dus sngar bya ba sbyin pa la rbe1gas pa dang yang dag phul gyi gtam las brtsams nas smra ba ste bstan pa'o/ /mdo sde rnam par bshad pa las brtsams nas brgal ba'i tshig bkod smra ba mtshams sbyar bar smra ba'o/ /rjes su mthun par smra ba ni 'dri ba'i lan lung bstan pa las brtsams te mgo gcig tu lung bstan pa la sogs pa rnams la de bzhin du lung ston pa'o/ /brjod pa go bar mi byed pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por gsum ste/ dad pa can rnams la dga' bar bya ba dang / sngar gnas pa dang zhe 'gras pa rnams la 'dod par bya ba dang / bar na gnas pa the tshom can rnams la mgu bar bya ba'o/ /brjod pa mchod par mi 'gyur ba'i skyon gyi gnyen por gnyis te/ sdig pa'i las can spro ba bskyed pa'i 'os ma yin pas spro ba mi bskyed pa dang / smad na snying na ru 'ong bas mi smad pa'o/ /don 'thad pa med par brjod pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por rigs pa ste tshad ma dang mi 'gal ba'o/ /don zab mo spyod yul ma yin pa dbang po tha ma la zab mo brjod pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por 'brel ba ste snga phyi 'brel ba'o/ /rnam par g.yengs nas brjod pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por ma 'dres pa ste gtam gzhan du 'phro ba spangs pa'o/ /don med pa brjod pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por chos dang ldan pa ste dge ba dang mthun pa'o/ /mi 'tshams par brjod pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por 'khor ji lta ba bzhin te gdul bya dang 'tshams pa'o/ /nyon mongs pa can gyi bsam pas brjod pa'i skyon gyi gnyen por lhag ma lnga'o/ /nyon mongs pa can gyi bsam pa ni gsum ste/ bdag bzang por yid ches par bya ba'i bsam pa dang / dad nas

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 99bkur sti byed par 'dod pa'i bsam pa dang / phrag dog gi bsam pa'o/ /dang po'i gnyen por gsum ste/ byams pa'i sems/ phan pa'i sems/ snying brtse ba'i sems gsum ni/ nyan pa po bde ba dang nyon mongs pa med pa dang sdug bsngal med par smon pa gsum mam/ dge ba dang mi dge ba la phyogs pa dang tha mal pa dag la byams sogs rim pa bzhin nam/ mya ngan las 'das pa dang / de'i lam rtogs par bya ba dang / bshad pa'i don khong du chud pa'i bsam pas so/ /gnyis pa'i gnyen por rnyed pa dang bkur sti dang tshigs su bcad pa la mi brten pa ste de dag 'dod pa spangs pa'o/ /gsum pa'i gnyen por bdag la bstod par mi bya zhing gzhan la smad par mi bya ba ste phrag dog dang bdag la lhag par yid ches par 'dod pa spangs pa'o/ /nyi shu po 'di lnga lnga rim pa bzhin/ ji lta bu dang / gang gi don du dang / gang 'dra ba'i dang / gang 'dra bas gtam bya ba dang / yang gtam gyi sbyor ba dang / gtam gyi las dang / gtam gyi yon tan dang / smra ba po'i yon tan bstan cing skyon dang bral ba ni/'chad byed la mkhas pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sgo gsum dge bas kun gyis bkur bar 'os pas rang gi kun spyod la mkhas pa dang / gdul bya'i kun spyod la mkhas pa ni dbang po dang khams dang bag la nyal shes pas de dang mthun pa'i chos bstan pas don du 'gyur gyi/sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu par/byis pa dbang po zhan cing le lo can/ /theg pa gnyis la nan tan mi byed par/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 99bkur sti byed par 'dod pa'i bsam pa dang / phrag dog gi bsam pa'o/ /dang po'i gnyen por gsum ste/ byams pa'i sems/ phan pa'i sems/ snying brtse ba'i sems gsum ni/ nyan pa po bde ba dang nyon mongs pa med pa dang sdug bsngal med par smon pa gsum mam/ dge ba dang mi dge ba la phyogs pa dang tha mal pa dag la byams sogs rim pa bzhin nam/ mya ngan las 'das pa dang / de'i lam rtogs par bya ba dang / bshad pa'i don khong du chud pa'i bsam pas so/ /gnyis pa'i gnyen por rnyed pa dang bkur sti dang tshigs su bcad pa la mi brten pa ste de dag 'dod pa spangs pa'o/ /gsum pa'i gnyen por bdag la bstod par mi bya zhing gzhan la smad par mi bya ba ste phrag dog dang bdag la lhag par yid ches par 'dod pa spangs pa'o/ /nyi shu po 'di lnga lnga rim pa bzhin/ ji lta bu dang / gang gi don du dang / gang 'dra ba'i dang / gang 'dra bas gtam bya ba dang / yang gtam gyi sbyor ba dang / gtam gyi las dang / gtam gyi yon tan dang / smra ba po'i yon tan bstan cing skyon dang bral ba ni/'chad byed la mkhas pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sgo gsum dge bas kun gyis bkur bar 'os pas rang gi kun spyod la mkhas pa dang / gdul bya'i kun spyod la mkhas pa ni dbang po dang khams dang bag la nyal shes pas de dang mthun pa'i chos bstan pas don du 'gyur gyi/sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu par/byis pa dbang po zhan cing le lo can/ /theg pa gnyis la nan tan mi byed par/ /

100 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/theg pa chen po'i 'khor lo ldan mi 'gyur/ /de ni rgya chen theg chen snod ma yin/ /zherngan pa4rdo34/de bzhin snod min nyan thos theg pa dag /theg chen bshad pa thos nas rmongs 'gyur zhing / /chad par blta la ngan song lhung 'gyur bas/ /des na dbang po brtags te chos bstan to / /zhes gsungs shing / yang / rgya chen chos kyi snod gyur pa/ /dman pa'i chos la sbyar mi bya/ /zhes pa dang / dman la zab dang rgya che dang / /zhes gsungs pas/ snod kyi kun spyod dam mtshan nyid la mkhas dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rab sems can thams cad byang chub chen po la gzhag 'dod kyi snying rje/ de med na gang 'chad pa'i don de legs par shes shing phan 'dod kyis zang zing la ltos med du 'chad pa'i snying rje nges par dgos te/ des rang gi bshad pa lam du 'gyur ro/ /mdo sde rgyan las/ brtan pa rnams ni srog dang longs spyod tshegs chen rnyed cing snying po med pa dag /rab dga'i yid kyis sems can sdug bsngal rnams la sbyin rnams rgya chen rtag gtong na/ /chos yang skye dgu rnams la rnam pa kun tu phan byed tshegs chen rnyed min zhing / /shin tu btang yang zad med 'phel 'gyur ba lta lan gcig ma yin smos ci dgos/ /zhes so/ /de lta min na chos 'tshong ba'i nyes par 'gyur te/ 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul pa'i mdo las/

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 101chos ston kyang chos nyan pa rnams la snying rje chen po mi bskyed pa ni/ bdud kyi las so/ /zhes pa dang / mang du thos kyang gzhan gyis shes kyis dogs te chos la slob dpon gyis dpe mkhyud byed pa yang bdud kyi las so/ /zhes pa dang / dgongs pa nges 'gre44 95thaṭa 'dod phyir su dag dam chos ston byed pa/ /de dag 'dod pa btang ba phyir len te/ /myos pa de dag thang med rin chen chos/ /thob par gyur kyang sprang por rgyu bar byed/ /ces so/ /gsum pa la/ 'chad dus kyi ngal dub dang dka' las la skyo ba med pa'i bzod pa/slob mas dri bar bzod pa/ gzhan gyis brtsad par bzod cing lan 'debs nus pa gsum gyis gdul bya rjes su 'dzin nus par 'gyur ro/ /'khor (rgetsang nag pa)gyis log sgrub bzod pa dgos gsung ste pha rol la phan nges par shes pa'i mngon shes dang ldan na de ltar bya ste/ de lta min par/ ma gus pa la chos mi bshad la sogs pa dang / do ker can la sogs pa lnga la sogs pa mang po dang 'gal bas ha cang blo sna ring pa'i gtam yin gyi/ chags sdang gis log par sgrub pa'i bshad nyan gyis mngon mtho'am nges legs ci zhig la phan/ de ltar chos de dag tshang bas bshad na 'khor gyi skye bo la 'jebs shing mdzes la lam du 'gyur te/mdo sde rgyan nas/de ltar blo bzang skyo ba med ldan brtse ba can/ /

102 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/snyan par rab grags cho ga bzang shes ldan pa yis/ /byang chub sems dpa' legs par smra ba yin pa ste/ /bshad pas skye bo'i nang na nyi ma bzhin du lham zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ mngon pa kun las btus su/ rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bcu bzhi dang drug gsungs te/ ji skad du/ rnam par bshad pa'i gtan la dbab pa gang zhe na/gang gis mdo sde rnams rnam par bshad par byed pa ste/ de'ang gang zhe na/ yongs su shes par bya ba'i dngos po dang / yongs su shes par bya ba'i don dang / yongs su shes par bya ba'i rgyu dang / yongs su shes pa dang / yongs su shes pa'i 'bras bu dang / des rab tu shes pa'o/ /yang rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bcu bzhi ste/ rnam par bshad pa bsdu ba'i sgo dang / dngos po bsdu pa'i sgo dang / yan lag dang nye ba'i yan lag gi sgo dang / gong nas gong du mngon par sgrub pa'i sgo dang / sbong ba'i sgo dang / yi ge yongs su bsgyur ba'i sgo dang / chud za ba dang mi za ba'i sgo dang / gang zag rnam par gzhag pa'i sgo dang / rab tu dbye ba rnam par gzhag pa'i sgo dang /tshul gyi sgo dang / yongs su shes pa la sogs pa'i sgo dang / stobs dang stobs ma sgyuyin pa'i sgo dang / bzlas te brjod pa'i sgo dang / mngon par sgrub pa'i sgo'o/ /zhes gsungs rbe1/ /gzhung kha cig las dgos don bsdus don tshig don gsum gyis 'chad cing /la lar spyi dang yan lag gi don gnyis kyis 'chad do/ /mchimasapa ni/ don bstan pa dang / gzhung bshad pa dang / de dag nges par bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhung gi ngag don skam phogs su bstan te/ gang las 'ongs pa'i

102 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/snyan par rab grags cho ga bzang shes ldan pa yis/ /byang chub sems dpa' legs par smra ba yin pa ste/ /bshad pas skye bo'i nang na nyi ma bzhin du lham zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ mngon pa kun las btus su/ rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bcu bzhi dang drug gsungs te/ ji skad du/ rnam par bshad pa'i gtan la dbab pa gang zhe na/gang gis mdo sde rnams rnam par bshad par byed pa ste/ de'ang gang zhe na/ yongs su shes par bya ba'i dngos po dang / yongs su shes par bya ba'i don dang / yongs su shes par bya ba'i rgyu dang / yongs su shes pa dang / yongs su shes pa'i 'bras bu dang / des rab tu shes pa'o/ /yang rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bcu bzhi ste/ rnam par bshad pa bsdu ba'i sgo dang / dngos po bsdu pa'i sgo dang / yan lag dang nye ba'i yan lag gi sgo dang / gong nas gong du mngon par sgrub pa'i sgo dang / sbong ba'i sgo dang / yi ge yongs su bsgyur ba'i sgo dang / chud za ba dang mi za ba'i sgo dang / gang zag rnam par gzhag pa'i sgo dang / rab tu dbye ba rnam par gzhag pa'i sgo dang /tshul gyi sgo dang / yongs su shes pa la sogs pa'i sgo dang / stobs dang stobs ma sgyuyin pa'i sgo dang / bzlas te brjod pa'i sgo dang / mngon par sgrub pa'i sgo'o/ /zhes gsungs rbe1/ /gzhung kha cig las dgos don bsdus don tshig don gsum gyis 'chad cing /la lar spyi dang yan lag gi don gnyis kyis 'chad do/ /mchimasapa ni/ don bstan pa dang / gzhung bshad pa dang / de dag nges par bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhung gi ngag don skam phogs su bstan te/ gang las 'ongs pa'i

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 103'brel/ ci'i phyir bkod pa 'i dgos pa/ ci zhig bstan pa'i brjod bya gsum gyis nges par byed pa ste/ des slob ma chos kyi don bzang bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dkyus kyi them sbyor gyis khyad par gyi gzhi ngos bzung ste/ dogs spang gi tshul gyis khyad par du byed pa'i chos bshad nas des don dngos shugs la ji ltar bstan dpyod pa ste/ des slob ma tshig la mkhas par byed do/ /gsum pa ni/ de dag gis gzhung don rtogs kyang gzhan gyi rgol ba mi bzlog pa srid pas/ bshad zin pa de nyid la 'gal zlos ma 'brel lo zhes bsam pa ma rtogs pa'i brgal ba bkod nas de'i bsam pa bsal byed kyi lan gdab pa dang /lung rigs gzhan gyi lan don dgongs pa can du dogs pa spangs pa ste/ des slob ma gzhung don la nges pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /rnam bshad rigs par/mdo don smra ba dag gis ni/ /dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang / /tshig don bcas dang mtshams sbyor bcas/ /brgal lan bcas par bsnyad par bya/ /brgal ba dang lan gnyis gcig tu bya ba ni brgal ba'i lan gdab pa'i don gyi phyir ro/ /zhes pas/ thog mar mdo la sogs pa'i dgos pa thos nas nyan pa dang 'dzin pa la 'bad par 'gyur bas dgos pa bshad/ de bsdus don las rtogs pas bsdus pa'i don mdo'am bstan bcos kyi lus sgra dang don gnyis sam/ brjod bya'i don dril nas ston pa'o/ /de tshig don las rtogs pas/ tshig gi don bshad gzhir bzhag nas khyad par gyi chos la dogs pa bsu ba'i sgo nas dri tshig

104 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/dang lan gyi mtha' dpyad nas 'chad pa'am/ don gcig la ming mang po dang ming gcig don mang po la 'jug pa dang / sgra'i zur gcig la drangs te 'chad pa dang /yi ge bsgyur nas 'chad pa dang / dgag pa'i sgra khong nas phyung ste tshig bsgyur nas 'chad pa la sogs pa'o/ /yang rnam bshad rigs par/ rnam pa gzhi dag gis tshig gi don rig par bya ste rnam grangs kyis dang mtshan nyid kyis dang nges pa'i tshig gis rab tu dbye bas so/ /de la rnam grangs ni ming gzhan no/ /mtshan nyid ni don gang la ming de yod pa'o/ /nges pa'i tshig ni ming gi rgyu mtshan brjod pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /kha cig nges tshig sgra'i bshad pa min par 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ a pra shi kha la sogs pa sgra'i bshad par gnas brgyad du bshad pas so/ /mtshams sbyar ni/don snga phyi 'brel ba dang / go rim snga phyi 'brel ba'i mtshams sbyar nas tshig don gyi go rim mi 'gal bar shes so/ /rigs pa dang mi 'gal ba dang snga phyi mi 'gal ba ni brgal lan las shes pas sgra la brgal ba dang don la 〈snal ba'i brgal ba bkod nas de'i don lan gyis nges par byas te 'chad pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gdul bya'i dbang gis dang / dgos pa'i dbang gis dang /'jug pa'i dbang gis bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ dbang po rno 'bring rtul gsum la bsdus 'bring rgyas par 'chad pa ste/ mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gsungs pa bzhin dang / rigs kyi bye brag gis theg pa che chung gi chos dang / don gnyer gyi bye brag gis bshad bya ci rigs par ston pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rgyal por/chos kyi sbyin pa'i ched kyi phyir/ /

104 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/dang lan gyi mtha' dpyad nas 'chad pa'am/ don gcig la ming mang po dang ming gcig don mang po la 'jug pa dang / sgra'i zur gcig la drangs te 'chad pa dang /yi ge bsgyur nas 'chad pa dang / dgag pa'i sgra khong nas phyung ste tshig bsgyur nas 'chad pa la sogs pa'o/ /yang rnam bshad rigs par/ rnam pa gzhi dag gis tshig gi don rig par bya ste rnam grangs kyis dang mtshan nyid kyis dang nges pa'i tshig gis rab tu dbye bas so/ /de la rnam grangs ni ming gzhan no/ /mtshan nyid ni don gang la ming de yod pa'o/ /nges pa'i tshig ni ming gi rgyu mtshan brjod pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /kha cig nges tshig sgra'i bshad pa min par 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ a pra shi kha la sogs pa sgra'i bshad par gnas brgyad du bshad pas so/ /mtshams sbyar ni/don snga phyi 'brel ba dang / go rim snga phyi 'brel ba'i mtshams sbyar nas tshig don gyi go rim mi 'gal bar shes so/ /rigs pa dang mi 'gal ba dang snga phyi mi 'gal ba ni brgal lan las shes pas sgra la brgal ba dang don la 〈snal ba'i brgal ba bkod nas de'i don lan gyis nges par byas te 'chad pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gdul bya'i dbang gis dang / dgos pa'i dbang gis dang /'jug pa'i dbang gis bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ dbang po rno 'bring rtul gsum la bsdus 'bring rgyas par 'chad pa ste/ mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gsungs pa bzhin dang / rigs kyi bye brag gis theg pa che chung gi chos dang / don gnyer gyi bye brag gis bshad bya ci rigs par ston pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rgyal por/chos kyi sbyin pa'i ched kyi phyir/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 105de dag khyod la gsol 'debs na/ /rab rgyas bdag gis ma bslab ces/ /thog mar tshig de brjod par bya/ / khyod ni shes shing mkhas yin na/ /bdag nyid chen po'i mdun du ni/ /bdag gis ji ltar bshad nus zhes/ /khyod kyis de skad brjod par bya/ /'phral du brjod par mi bya yi/ /༷1da la brtag pa byas nas bya/ /gal te snod du shes gyur na/ /gsol ma btab kyang bshad par bya/ / 'bor ni mang po 'bod nang du/ /gal te ngang tshul ngan mthong na/ / khyod kyi yo byad bsnyungs mi bshad/ /sbyin pa'i bsngags pa brjod par bya/ /gal te 'dod pa chung zhig ste/ /tshul khrims dag par gnas yin na/ /khyod kyis byams pa'i sems bskyed la/ /yo byad bsnyungs pa'i gtam gyis shig /gal te sdig 'dod chung gyur cing / /

106 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/tshul khrims ldan pa mang gyur la/ /gnyen po rnyed pa de yi tshe/ /tshul khrims bsngags pa brjod par bya/ /zhes bshad pa bzhin ces/ /gnyis pa ni/ dgos pa don du gnyer ba'i bye brag gis mtshan nyid gtan la dbab pa dang / sgrub pa nyams len ci rigs par 'chad pa'o/ /gsum pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ sbyor ba la/ bkod pa bshams pa dang / dkon mchog la gsol ba gdab pa dang / bdud tshar gcod cing 'khor la byams pas khyab par bya ba gsum mo/ /dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las/mkhas pa dus su sems par byed pa na/ /khang bur zhugs te de bzhin sgo bcad nas/ /chos 'di thams cad la ni tshul bzhin lta/ /langs nas zhum pa med pa'i sems kyis rbeshad/ /mkhas pa bde la rtag tu gnas par 'gyur/ /bde la 'dug nas de bzhin chos kyang ston/ /gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /yangs pa'i stan ni rab tu bshams bting ste/ /bzang po'i tshon gyis legs par kha bsgyur pa/ /chos gos gtsang ma des ni rab bgos nas/ /

106 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/tshul khrims ldan pa mang gyur la/ /gnyen po rnyed pa de yi tshe/ /tshul khrims bsngags pa brjod par bya/ /zhes bshad pa bzhin ces/ /gnyis pa ni/ dgos pa don du gnyer ba'i bye brag gis mtshan nyid gtan la dbab pa dang / sgrub pa nyams len ci rigs par 'chad pa'o/ /gsum pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ sbyor ba la/ bkod pa bshams pa dang / dkon mchog la gsol ba gdab pa dang / bdud tshar gcod cing 'khor la byams pas khyab par bya ba gsum mo/ /dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las/mkhas pa dus su sems par byed pa na/ /khang bur zhugs te de bzhin sgo bcad nas/ /chos 'di thams cad la ni tshul bzhin lta/ /langs nas zhum pa med pa'i sems kyis rbeshad/ /mkhas pa bde la rtag tu gnas par 'gyur/ /bde la 'dug nas de bzhin chos kyang ston/ /gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /yangs pa'i stan ni rab tu bshams bting ste/ /bzang po'i tshon gyis legs par kha bsgyur pa/ /chos gos gtsang ma des ni rab bgos nas/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 107rngul gzan nag po de bzhin bshams byas la/ /sham thabs che tshad legs par rab bgos nas/ /bcos bu'i ras rnams sna tshogs legs bting ba/ /rkang rten bcas pa'i khri la rab 'dug cing / /rkang pa legs par bkrus te steng 'jog nas/ /gdong dang bzhin gyi mdangs ni rab snum zhing / /chos kyi stan de la ni rab 'dug nas/ /sems can lhags pa rtse gcig gyur rnams la/ /gtam yang rnam pa sna tshogs nye bar ston/ /dge slong dag dang dge slong ma dag dang / /dge bsnyen rnams dang dge bsnyen ma dag dang / / rgyal po dag dang rgyal bu rnams la yang / /mkhas de rtag tu phrag dog med par ni/ /sna tshogs don ldan snyan pa'i gtam yang ston/ /le lo dag kyang rnam par rab spangs nas/ /skyo ba snyam pa'i 'du shes bskyed mi bya/ /mkhas pas mi dga' thams cad rnam par spang / /byams pa'i stobs ni 'bor la sgom par bya/ /nyin mtshan du yang chos mchog rab tu sgom/ /mkhas pa des ni bye ba khrag khrig dpes/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 107rngul gzan nag po de bzhin bshams byas la/ /sham thabs che tshad legs par rab bgos nas/ /bcos bu'i ras rnams sna tshogs legs bting ba/ /rkang rten bcas pa'i khri la rab 'dug cing / /rkang pa legs par bkrus te steng 'jog nas/ /gdong dang bzhin gyi mdangs ni rab snum zhing / /chos kyi stan de la ni rab 'dug nas/ /sems can lhags pa rtse gcig gyur rnams la/ /gtam yang rnam pa sna tshogs nye bar ston/ /dge slong dag dang dge slong ma dag dang / /dge bsnyen rnams dang dge bsnyen ma dag dang / / rgyal po dag dang rgyal bu rnams la yang / /mkhas de rtag tu phrag dog med par ni/ /sna tshogs don ldan snyan pa'i gtam yang ston/ /le lo dag kyang rnam par rab spangs nas/ /skyo ba snyam pa'i 'du shes bskyed mi bya/ /mkhas pas mi dga' thams cad rnam par spang / /byams pa'i stobs ni 'bor la sgom par bya/ /nyin mtshan du yang chos mchog rab tu sgom/ /mkhas pa des ni bye ba khrag khrig dpes/ /

108 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/'khor rnams mgu zhing de bzhin dga' bar byed/ /de la nam yang 'dod pa cung zad med/ /zas dang skom dang bza' dang bca' ba dang / /gos dang mal cha chos gos rnams dang ni/ /na ba'i gsos sman dag kyang mi bsam ste/ /'khor rnams la ni ci yang mi bslang ngo / /gzhan du mkhas pa rtag tu bdag nyid dang / /sems can 'di dag sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /phan phyir 'jig rten chos gang bstan pa ste/ /bdag gi bde ba'i yo byad kun snyam sems/ /zhes pa dang / blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ tadu thā/ sha me sha ma ba ti sha mi ta sha tru/ e ku re/ mo ku re/ mā ra dzi te kā ra de yu ke yā re te dzo ba ti/ o lo ya ni/ bi sha tha nime le/ ma la pā na yī/ khu khu re kha ge gra se/ gra sa ni/ tse( mu khri/ pa ram̐ mu khri/ a mu khri sha mi tā ni/ sar+bha gra hā ban+dha na ni/ gri hi tā sar+bhar pra bā ti na/ bi mu ghā mā ra pra sha/ s+thā bi twa bud+dha mu tra/ ā nu ta gha ti tā/ sar+bha ma re su tsa ri ta pa ri shud+dhi/ bi gats+tsha n+tu sar+bha mā ra karma ṇi/ blo gros rgya mtsho/ 'di dag ni/ bdud tshar gcod pa'i tshig nyon mongs pa bsal ba'i tshig ste/ de dag chos smra ba des legs par kha ton du byas la chos kyi khri la 'dug ste/ byang chub kyi rnam par mngon par bsgrubs pa'i byams pas 'khor thams cad la khyab par byas la bdag la sman pa'i 'du shes bskyed de/ chos la sman gyi 'du shes dang / chos nyan pa la nad pa'i
