dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 109'du shes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la skyes bu dam pa'i 'du shes dang / chos kyi tshul la yun ring du gnas pa'i 'du shes bskyed la/ sngags kyi tshig 'di dag sngon du byas te/ chos kyi gtam bshad na/ de'i khor yug dpag tshad brgya tshun chad du bdud dang bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams mig bsgyur ba'i las kyis phyir 'ong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang dag 'ong ba de dag kyang bar chad byed par mi nus so zhes pa dang /chos smra bas gtsang sbra dang kun tu spyod pa gtsang ba dang legs par bkrus pa dang /legs par gos bgo bar bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ phar phyin drug ldan te/ rang gis rtogs pa'i tshig don ster ba dang / sgo gsum gyi nyes spyod sdom pa dang / tsha grang la sogs pa gnod pa sron pa dang / bshad pa la spro ba dang / de la sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa dang /tshig don gyi 'gal 'brel dpyod cing 'chad pa ste drug gam/ yang na slob dpon seng ge bzang pos/ chos kyi sbyin pa la sogs pa sbyin pa na nyan thos la sogs pa'i yid la byed pa spong ba dang / skye bo thams cad mi snyan par smra ba la sogs bzod pa dang / 'dun pa skyed pa dang / theg pa gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i sems rtse gcig pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba rnams mi dmigs pa'i go cha nyid kyis byed pa/ dang zhes pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa rjes la nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang / dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba dang / stong pa'i rgyas gdab pa'o/ /gsum pa (3|ba mas nyan tshul gyi khyad pare/la/ gang gis nyan pa'i gang zagagang la brten nas nyan pa'i thabs/ ji ltar nyan pa'i tshul gsum mo/ /dang po la/nyan pa po rab 'bring tha gsum las/ dang po la/ rnam bcad nyan pa po'i skyon spang

110 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/ba dang / bsgrub bya nyan pa po'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'o/ /dang po la/ skyon bcu gsum dang / trug dang / gsum sngong ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rnam bshad rigs par/ skyon bcu gsum gyi gnyen por rnam pa bcu drug gis chos mnyan par gsungs shing / bcu gsum ni nang du yang dag par 'jog pa'i tshe smra ba po la bdag nyid kyis bskyod pa dang / spyod lam mi sdug pa'i skyon dang / rigs mtho ba la sogs pa'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba'i skyon dang / don du mi gnyer ba'i skyon dang / gzhan gyi phyogs byed pas snying na ba'i skyon dang /mchod par mi 'gyur bas smra ba po rab tu mi 'dzin pa'i skyon dang / sun ci phyin du rgol ba'i bsam pa'i skyon dang / chos dang chos smra ba la yon tan yid la mi byed pa'i phyir rim gro mi byed pa'i skyon dang / chos la tshig dang yig 'bru ma 'brel ba'am chos smra ba la tshul khrims dang rigs dang byad gzugs dang tshig 'byin pa ma tshang ba la sogs pa'i skyon yid la byed pa'i phyir brnyas pa'i skyon dang / smod pa'i skyon dang / rnyed pa dang / bkur sti 'dod pa'i skyon dang / sems rnam par g.yengs pa dang gnyid rmugs kyis bsdus pas mi nyan pa'i skyon dang / dgongs pa dang chos nyid la phyin ci log tu rtog pas legs par yid la mi byed pa'i skyon dang / 'dun pa dang 'jug pa zhan pa nyid kyis rab tu yid la mi byed pa'i skyon no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rnam bshad rigs par/nga rgyal dang ni ma dad dang / /don du gnyer ba med nyid dang / /phyi rol rnam g.yeng nang bsdus dang / /skyo bas nyan pa dri ma yin/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 111zhes pa ltar ram/ yang na las kyi skyon dang / mos pa med pa'i skyon dang / mchod par mi 'gyur ba'i skyon dang / bsam pa'i skyon dang / mi mthun pa'i skyon dang /'dzin pa'i skyon no/ /las kyi skyon la lus kyi las spyod lam mi sdug pa dang / lus ngag gnyis ka'i las de gnyis kyis bskul bar mi byed pa dang / yid kyi las nyan par mi 'dod pa'o/ /bsam pa'i skyon ni gzhan la klan ka btsal ba dang / 'di lta bu zhig tu rgol ba las thar par bya ba'i bsam pa'o/ /mi mthun pa'i skyon lnga ste/chos la nges 'byin gyi lam min par go nas mi gus pa dang / tshig dang yi ge ma 'brel bas bsnyad pa dang / gang zag dang tshul khrims dang tshig 'byin pa'i skyon gyis gus pa med pa dang / rigs kyi skyon gyis brnyas pa'o/ /khong du chud pa dang sgrub pa'i nus pa mi 'byung snyam pa bdag la brnyas pa'o/ /'dzin pa'i skyon lnga ste/log par 'dzin pa dang / don mi 'dzin pa dang / tshig 'bru mi 'dzin pa dang / brda ma 'phrod par 'dzin pa dang / ma lus par mi 'dzin pa'o/ /gsum pa la dper na char bab kyang chu'i bya ba mi byed pa'i snod kyi skyon gsum 'byung ste/ kha bub bam bcad pas mi 'bab pa dang / mi gtsang bas bab kyang skyon can du 'gyur ba dang / bu ga dang bcas pas bab kyang mi gnas pa'o/ /de bzhin du chos kyi char bab kyang chos kyi chu'i bya ba mi byed pa'i skyon gsum ste/ rnam g.yeng dang gnyid rmugs kyis mi nyan pas mi 'bab pa dang / tshul bzhin yid la mi byed pas bab kyang skyon can du 'gyur ba dang / dran pa brjed nges pa'i phyir mi gnas pa'o/ /de'i gnyen por/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig dang / zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang nad pa sman pa'i lung ma shes pa dang log par shes pa dang legs par shes kyang sman chud gsan pa dang 'dra ba

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 111zhes pa ltar ram/ yang na las kyi skyon dang / mos pa med pa'i skyon dang / mchod par mi 'gyur ba'i skyon dang / bsam pa'i skyon dang / mi mthun pa'i skyon dang /'dzin pa'i skyon no/ /las kyi skyon la lus kyi las spyod lam mi sdug pa dang / lus ngag gnyis ka'i las de gnyis kyis bskul bar mi byed pa dang / yid kyi las nyan par mi 'dod pa'o/ /bsam pa'i skyon ni gzhan la klan ka btsal ba dang / 'di lta bu zhig tu rgol ba las thar par bya ba'i bsam pa'o/ /mi mthun pa'i skyon lnga ste/chos la nges 'byin gyi lam min par go nas mi gus pa dang / tshig dang yi ge ma 'brel bas bsnyad pa dang / gang zag dang tshul khrims dang tshig 'byin pa'i skyon gyis gus pa med pa dang / rigs kyi skyon gyis brnyas pa'o/ /khong du chud pa dang sgrub pa'i nus pa mi 'byung snyam pa bdag la brnyas pa'o/ /'dzin pa'i skyon lnga ste/log par 'dzin pa dang / don mi 'dzin pa dang / tshig 'bru mi 'dzin pa dang / brda ma 'phrod par 'dzin pa dang / ma lus par mi 'dzin pa'o/ /gsum pa la dper na char bab kyang chu'i bya ba mi byed pa'i snod kyi skyon gsum 'byung ste/ kha bub bam bcad pas mi 'bab pa dang / mi gtsang bas bab kyang skyon can du 'gyur ba dang / bu ga dang bcas pas bab kyang mi gnas pa'o/ /de bzhin du chos kyi char bab kyang chos kyi chu'i bya ba mi byed pa'i skyon gsum ste/ rnam g.yeng dang gnyid rmugs kyis mi nyan pas mi 'bab pa dang / tshul bzhin yid la mi byed pas bab kyang skyon can du 'gyur ba dang / dran pa brjed nges pa'i phyir mi gnas pa'o/ /de'i gnyen por/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig dang / zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang nad pa sman pa'i lung ma shes pa dang log par shes pa dang legs par shes kyang sman chud gsan pa dang 'dra ba

112 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/ dang / nad pa zas mi za ba dang / mi 'phrod pa za ba dang / 'phrod pa zos pa skyug pa gsum rim pa bzhin no/ /des na 'chad pa po snod la mkhas pas nyan po rnam par g.yengs na/ mi rnams tshe ni lo brgya la/ /mtshan mo nyal bas phyed du byas/ /de ni nyin par yang nyal bas/ /de yi phyed kyang dum bur byas/ /zhes pa la sogs pa skyo ba'i gtam bya/ gnyid rmugs can la sems gsal bar bya ba'i phyir ya mtshan gyi gtam dang / bong bu dang rte'u 'am/ seng ge dang wa'am/ rgan zhugs dang bud med dang / rgan mo dang rkun mo dang / lus skyes ngus pa'i gtam rgyud bshad la dga' ba'i gtam bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bzhi brgya pa las/ gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer ba/ /nyan po snod ces bya bar brjod/ /ces pas rtogs par nus pa'i blo gros dang / don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa dang / nga rgyal med pa'i gus pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thos pa nyon mongs kyi gnyen por 'gro zhing thar pa'i rgyur 'gro ba la don rtogs dgos te/ dbyig gnyen gyis/ rgyu gsum dag gis pags pa las su rung bar 'gyur te snum bku ba dang mnye ba dang bsro ba rnams kyis so/ /de bzhin du sems kyang thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa rnams kyis so/ /de lta bas na sems las su rung ba nyid du bya ba'i phyir thos pa la sogs pa dag la brtson 'grus bya'o/ /gsum po de dag gi stobs kyis lam du 'gro ba rnams 'brog dgon pa'i lam las bde bar brgal bar 'gyur te lam rgyags kyi stobs dang bzhon pa'i stobs dang ston pa po'i stobs kyis so/ /de bzhin du 'bor ba'i 'brog dgon pa'i lam las bde ba'i lam du 'gro ba rnams sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang ye shes kyi stobs kyis so/ /'di gsum char yang thos pa la rag las so zhes so/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 113gnyis pa ni/ mdo las bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i chos yongs su 'tshol ba ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ g.yo dang sgyu med par bsam pa thag pas chos yongs su 'tshol ba dang zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ 'grel chen du lhag pa'i bsam pas mnyan par bya zhes bya ba ni/thod la sogs pa bor la stan dma' ba la 'dug ste rnam par g.yeng ba'i nyes pa bsal te thar pa 'dod pa'i bsam pas dam pa'i chos mnyan par bya'o zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i mtshan nyid ma tshang yang don go bar nus pa mnyan na phan yon chen po yod de/ rnam bshad rigs par/ rgyu bsags pa rnams ni cung zad mnyan pas bsod nams chen po dang ldan par 'gyur te/ dper na 'phags pa shā ri'i bus bsnyen par rdzogs par bya ba la rjes su bstan pa bram ze zhig gis thos nas gab ste 'dug nas rab tu byung ba tshul khrims nyams pa la sdug bsngal rnam pa bcu gnyis 'byung ngo zhes thos nas 'chal ba'i tshul khrims bya ba la mngon du phyogs pa las ldog pa lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang dge 'dun srung gis chos bstan pa la drang srong rnams kyis phag nyan byas pas 'bras bu thob pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ don mi go yang chos la dad nas mnyan na bsod nams che ste/ ji skad du/ brda mi 'phrod pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi gsung gus pas mnyan par bya ste/'di ltar dad pa tsam gyis kyang nyan na bsod nams chen po nyid dang ldan pa dang /shes rab kyi khams brtas par 'gyur na don rtogs pas lta smos kyang ci dgos te ba lang rdzi dga' bos sbal ba mkhar bas mnan pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dper bya'o zhes pa dang / chos dga' chu srin du gyur pa na sangs rgyas kyi sgra tsam zhig thos

114 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/pa las sngon phyag 'tshal ba tsam la goms pa'i phyir kha btsums te 'dug pa yin no/ /de lta bas na cung zad cig thos pas kyang rgyu bsags pa rnams kyi dge ba rab tu rgyas pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung nyan pa la 'bad pa dang ldan par bya'o zhes so/ / gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/gang gis sems can dag 'gyur ba'i/ /rgyu gnyis dang ni rkyen gnyis te/ /gzhan la rjes su mthun sgra dang / /nang du tshul bzhin lta ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ phyi'i rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten cing 'tsho ba'i yo byad bsags pa dang / nang gi mthun rkyen rna ba blags te mnyan cing thos pa'i don bsam pa dang mdo bstan bcos blta ba dang mkhas pa la dri bas bskyang bar bya zhing / des thos byung mthar phyin par 'gyur zhing de nas bsam bsgom la 'bad par bya'o/ /rnam bshad rigs par/ rdo thal gyi rdo mes bsregs chus 'jig par byed pa dang 'dra bar nyon mongs pa'i bag la nyal gyi rdo shes rab kyi mes yongs su bsregs pas ting nge 'dzin gyi chus yongs su sbangs na 'jig go /shes rab de'ang dam pa'i chos mnyan pa med par ni ma yin pas de lta bas na gus pas chos nyan par bya'o/ /tshig gi khur thogs kyang don mngon par mi shes na de'i don mi 'thob ste khye'u'i mgul du gter gyi kha chems kyi yi ge btags pa dang 'dra'o/ /de lta bas na mang du thos pas kyang don shes pa nyid du bya ba'i phyir mdo sde'i don mnyan pa la

114 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/pa las sngon phyag 'tshal ba tsam la goms pa'i phyir kha btsums te 'dug pa yin no/ /de lta bas na cung zad cig thos pas kyang rgyu bsags pa rnams kyi dge ba rab tu rgyas pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung nyan pa la 'bad pa dang ldan par bya'o zhes so/ / gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/gang gis sems can dag 'gyur ba'i/ /rgyu gnyis dang ni rkyen gnyis te/ /gzhan la rjes su mthun sgra dang / /nang du tshul bzhin lta ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ phyi'i rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten cing 'tsho ba'i yo byad bsags pa dang / nang gi mthun rkyen rna ba blags te mnyan cing thos pa'i don bsam pa dang mdo bstan bcos blta ba dang mkhas pa la dri bas bskyang bar bya zhing / des thos byung mthar phyin par 'gyur zhing de nas bsam bsgom la 'bad par bya'o/ /rnam bshad rigs par/ rdo thal gyi rdo mes bsregs chus 'jig par byed pa dang 'dra bar nyon mongs pa'i bag la nyal gyi rdo shes rab kyi mes yongs su bsregs pas ting nge 'dzin gyi chus yongs su sbangs na 'jig go /shes rab de'ang dam pa'i chos mnyan pa med par ni ma yin pas de lta bas na gus pas chos nyan par bya'o/ /tshig gi khur thogs kyang don mngon par mi shes na de'i don mi 'thob ste khye'u'i mgul du gter gyi kha chems kyi yi ge btags pa dang 'dra'o/ /de lta bas na mang du thos pas kyang don shes pa nyid du bya ba'i phyir mdo sde'i don mnyan pa la

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'a 5ga tshul/ 115'bad pa dang ldan par bya'o/ /mel tshe ba so sor mi rtog pa ni ma nyal zhes zer bzhin du chom po rnams kyis bcom mo/ /de bzhin du sgra tsam la brtson pa'i mang du thos pa so sor mi rtog pa yang nyon mongs pa'i dgra rnams kyis 'joms so so sor rtog pa de yang don shes pa nyid med na med pas de lta bas na don gzung bar ni 'bad pa dang ldan par bya'o/ /de bzhin du rol mo mkhan rkun pos 'jigs nas mi nyal bar bya ba'i phyir glu len bzhin du bcom mo/ /zhes bya ba yang dper brjod par bya'o/ /ji ltar long ba mar me 'dzin pa ni/ gzhan dag la phan par 'gyur ba dang 'dra bar don mngon par mi shes pa'i thos pa 'dzin pa yang de lta bu yin pas/ de lta bas na don shes pa nyid du bya ba'i phyir don mnyan pa la 'bad par bya'o zhes so/ /gsum pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum/ dang po la gsum las/dang po chos sgrub pa'i bsam pa ste/ ji skad du/ thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa gtso bor byed/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa gus pa'i spyod lam ste/ sgo gsum 'dud pa'o/ /skyes rabs su/rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni rnam par bskyed/ /dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta/ /tshig gis bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin/ /gus pa bskyed de rtse gcig btud/ /rab tu dang la dri med yid/ /

116 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/nad pas sman pa'i tshig mnyan bzhin/ /rim gro bskyed de chos nyon cig /ces so/ /gsum pa rkyen tshogasapar dga' ba sgomapa ste/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab par/'jig rten sangs rgyas 'byung ba brgya lam ste/ /mi yi lus ni tshegs kyis rnyed pa yin/ /kye ma dad pa dang ni chos nyan pa/ /'di 'dra bskal pa brgyar yang rnyed par dka'/ /zhes pa dang / rgya cher rol par/mi dang sangs rgyas 'byung rnyed dka'/ /dad pa'ang shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /mi khom brgyad spangs rnyed par dka'/ /chos nyan pa ni gtso bo yin/ /sangs rgyas 'byung dang dal ba dang / /dad dang chos mnyan dam pa dang / /de dag thams cad da rnyed kyis/ /bag med ma lus rnam par sbongs/ /gal te bskal pa khrag khrig tu/ /chos thos mi 'gyur srid pa de/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 117khyed kyis de ring rnyed zin gyi/ /bag med ma lus rnam par spongs/ /zhes pa dang / rnam bshad rigs par/gsung dang rna ba nyid dang ni/ /'dod dang shes rab gegs med pa/ /lnga ni gang phyir rnyed dka' ba/ /de phyir thub pa'i gsung mnyan bya/ /zhes pa dang /lus can 'di nas shi na yang / /dam chos dkon mchog 'phrad 'gyur ram/ /mi 'gyur rna bar thos pa dang / /su zhig dam chos 'chad 'gyur ba/ /de ni sus kyang mi shes pas/ /de phyir khyed kyis 'bad pa yis/ /ston pa'i gsung ni mnyan par bya/ /zhes pa dang /srid pa yod na gdon mi za bar tshe thob la/ /

118 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/de yang phal cher don med par ni zad par 'gyur/ /legs par gan+da/ngas pa'ang sa steng 'ga' na lan 'ga' zhig /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin du snang ba yin/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ phar phyin drug ldan te/ sgo gsum chos kyi phyir gtong ba dang / nyes spyod sdom zhing snod kyi skyon rnams spong ba dang / gnod pa bzod pa dang / nyan pa la spro ba dang / sgra dang don la sems rtse gcig pa dang / rab rtogs pa lhag pa rnyed pa'am/ 'bring sgra'i rjes su 'brangs pas 'dzin skyong don la dpyod pa'o/ /mtha' ma la tshad med do/ /gsum pa rjes la nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing dge ba bsngos la gtang rag gi phyag bya'o/ /bzhi pa rtoganyis kas chos kyi don sgrub par gdams bye/ni/ de lta bu'i thos bsam lam du 'a11 ba la/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes pas tshul khrims dag pa rten du dgos te/ ting nge 'dzin (zla ba sgron me dang gcirge) rgyal po las/ji snyed chos kyi rnam par byang chub kyang / /thos pas rgyags shing tshul khrims mi srung na/ /tshul khrims 'chal ba ngan 'gro der 'gro ste/ /de la thos pa mang pos skyob mi nus/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mang thos tshul gnas kyang bsam sgo ma dang 'brel dgos te

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 119btsun pa chos la gnas pa'i dge slong zhes bya ba'i mdo las/ bsgom pa la ma brten par thos pa dang / sems pa'i sbyor ba 'ba' zhig gis kyang chos la gnas pa ma yin la/ thos pa dang sems pa la ma brten par bsgom pa la rjeXr ba 'ba' zhig gis kyang chos la gnas pa ma yin gyi/ gnyis ka la brten te gnyis ka la gnas na chos la gnas pa yin no zhes gsungs so/ /mdo sde rgyan las kyang /de ltar rnal 'byor can gyi bsgom pa gang yin de yang don med min/ /de ltar bde bar gshegs kyis bstan pa gang yin de yang don med min/ /gal te thos pa tsam gyis don mthong 'gyur na bsgom pa don med 'gyur/ /gal te ma thos par yang bsgom 'jug 'gyur na bstan pa don med 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na thog mar sdug bsngal mang po'i gzhi'am rgyu 'chal ba'i tshul khrims kyi gnyen por tshul khrims srung zhing / de nas nyon mongs pa rnam par sbyang ba la 'bad par bya'o/ /de'i rim pa ni/ zhi ba lhas/bzod bya thos pa btsal bar bya/ /de nas nags su gnas par bya/ /mnyam par gzhag la bcerdzon bya zhing / /mi sdug la sogs bsgom par bya/ /zhes so/ /de la thog mar bzod pa dgos te/ de med na skyo ba la ji mi snyam pa med pas thos pa la mi 'jug pas so/ /thos pa med na nyon mongs sbong ba'i bsam gtan gyi thabs mi shes pas thos pa btsal lo/ /thos pas chos shes su zin kyang

120 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/lang long can du spyod na ting nge 'dzin mi skye bas/chos dang mthun pa'i tshig gis smras gyur kyang / /khro dang zhe sdang yid mi ches pa dag /rab tu smra ste 'di ni byis pa'i chos/ /don de rnam par shes na yid mi rton/ /zhes zla ba sgron me las 'byung ba bzhin bsnyen bkur 'dod sred byis pa dang 'grogs pa spangs te/nags na ri dwags bya rnams dang / /shing rnams mi snyan sgrog mi byed/ /'grogs na bde ba de dag dang / /nam zhig lhan cig gnas par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i nags dben pa bsten no/ /de nas rnam g.yeng spong ba la mi brtson na mnyam par 'jog par mi 'gyur bas/ mnyam gzhag la brtson dgos la/ de'i 'bras bu nyon mongs pa sbyong ba yin pas mi sdug pa la sogs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /mang du thos kyang sgrub pa dang bral ba ni/ nyes pa chen po ste/ drag shul can gyis zhus par/ gal te thos pa dang ldan pa dal ba phun tshogs pa 'di rnyed nas rnyed pa la sogs pa la chags pa'i sems mi sbyong na de ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la bslu ba gcig pur 'gyur ro zhes pa dang / dkon brtsegs las kyang 'od srungs 'di lta ste/ dper na mi la la zhig rgya mtsho'i chu chen pos khyer ba chus skom bzhin du

120 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/lang long can du spyod na ting nge 'dzin mi skye bas/chos dang mthun pa'i tshig gis smras gyur kyang / /khro dang zhe sdang yid mi ches pa dag /rab tu smra ste 'di ni byis pa'i chos/ /don de rnam par shes na yid mi rton/ /zhes zla ba sgron me las 'byung ba bzhin bsnyen bkur 'dod sred byis pa dang 'grogs pa spangs te/nags na ri dwags bya rnams dang / /shing rnams mi snyan sgrog mi byed/ /'grogs na bde ba de dag dang / /nam zhig lhan cig gnas par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i nags dben pa bsten no/ /de nas rnam g.yeng spong ba la mi brtson na mnyam par 'jog par mi 'gyur bas/ mnyam gzhag la brtson dgos la/ de'i 'bras bu nyon mongs pa sbyong ba yin pas mi sdug pa la sogs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /mang du thos kyang sgrub pa dang bral ba ni/ nyes pa chen po ste/ drag shul can gyis zhus par/ gal te thos pa dang ldan pa dal ba phun tshogs pa 'di rnyed nas rnyed pa la sogs pa la chags pa'i sems mi sbyong na de ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la bslu ba gcig pur 'gyur ro zhes pa dang / dkon brtsegs las kyang 'od srungs 'di lta ste/ dper na mi la la zhig rgya mtsho'i chu chen pos khyer ba chus skom bzhin du

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 121'chi ba'i dus byed pa de bzhin du 'od srungs 'di la dge sbyong dang bram ze kha cig chos mang po bslabs te kun chub par byas kyang / 'dod chags la sred pa mi sel/zhe sdang la sred pa mi sel/ gti mug la sred pa mi sel ba de dag chos kyi rgya mtshos khyer la nyon mongs pa'i skom pas 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur te ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur ro zhes so/ /des na bdag lta bu kha bshad la song nas lag len med pa la snying po med pas don sems shing lag len gal che ste/ lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ba'i mdo las/thos pas rgyags na gus par mi 'gyur te/ /rnam par 'gyed pa'i smra ba rnams la chags/ /brjod par 'gyur zhing shes bzhin med par 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /nang gi sems las shin tu ring bar 'gyur/ /lus dang sems kyang rab sbyangs ma yin 'gyur/ /khengs pa dang ni mdud pa mang po 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /byis pa dam pa'i chos bsam rab tu nyams/ /sems ni mi mnyen shin tu rtsub par 'gyur/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong dag dang rab tu ring / /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /rtag tu bla ma dag la gus pa med/ /

122 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/sbags pa'i gtam dag la ni dga' ba bskyed/ /snying po med la gnas shing shes rab nyams/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /de ni lha tshogs rnams kyis mi bkur zhing / /de tshe de la'ang 'dod pa mi bskyed la/ /so so yang dag rig las nyams 'gyur te/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /gang dag lus ni mngon sum mang yod pa/ /mkhas pa de dag gis ni spyo bar 'gyur/ /de yi srog ni don med 'gyur ba ste/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /bdag ni sgrub nyams da ni ci bya zhes / /'chi ba'i dus tshe byis pa mya ngan byed/ /gting rnyed ma gyur shin tu sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /rtswa bskyod bzhin du 'gul zhing g.yo ba ste/ /de ni de ltar the tshom 'gyur du nges/ /de ni nam yang blo brtan mi 'gyur te/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /gar la dga' ba'i khrod na 'dug pa zhig /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 123dpa' bo gzhan gyi yon tan brjod pa bzhin/ /bdag nyid nan tan nyams par 'gyur ba ste/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /de ni g.yo ldan yang zhing re 'chad 'gyur/ /phyir phyir zhing ni rnam par 'gyed pa rtsom/ /'phags pa'i dam pa'i chos las rab tu ring / /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /mthu chung bsti stang gis ni dga' 'gyur te/ /mi shes ldan pa g.yo zhing 'gyur ba yi/ /spre'u ltar de yi sems ni g.yo bar 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /rang gi blo yi shes pa dma' ba'i phyir/ /rmongs pa de ni gzhan gyi dring la 'jog /de ni nyon mongs phyogs kyi dbang du 'gro /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /mig kyang 'khrul zhing de bzhin rna ba'ang 'khrul / /sna yang 'a(spyil zhing de bzhin lce yang 'a(spyil/ /lus kyang 'khrul zhing yid kyang 'khrul bar 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /de yi sems ni rna ba'i rnam shes la/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 123dpa' bo gzhan gyi yon tan brjod pa bzhin/ /bdag nyid nan tan nyams par 'gyur ba ste/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /de ni g.yo ldan yang zhing re 'chad 'gyur/ /phyir phyir zhing ni rnam par 'gyed pa rtsom/ /'phags pa'i dam pa'i chos las rab tu ring / /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /mthu chung bsti stang gis ni dga' 'gyur te/ /mi shes ldan pa g.yo zhing 'gyur ba yi/ /spre'u ltar de yi sems ni g.yo bar 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /rang gi blo yi shes pa dma' ba'i phyir/ /rmongs pa de ni gzhan gyi dring la 'jog /de ni nyon mongs phyogs kyi dbang du 'gro /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /mig kyang 'khrul zhing de bzhin rna ba'ang 'khrul / /sna yang 'a(spyil zhing de bzhin lce yang 'a(spyil/ /lus kyang 'khrul zhing yid kyang 'khrul bar 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /de yi sems ni rna ba'i rnam shes la/ /

124 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/rab tu chags shing sgras rgyags shes rab nyams/ /log par sems shing lam ngan 'gro bar 'gyur/ /smra la dga' ba'i nyes pa 'di dag go /zhes pa la rbedugs pa garna/ngas nas/yun ring dus nas smra la dga' bas na/ /de ni bdag nyid dga' ba mi thob bo/ /tshig gang dga' ba mtha' yas thob 'gyur ba/ /tshig gcig tsam zhig bsams kyang mchog yin no/ /bu ram shing shun snying po ci yang med/ /dga' bar bya ba'i ro ni nang na 'dug /shun pa zos pas mis ni bu ram ro/ /zhim po rnyed par nus pa ma yin no/ /ji ltar shun pa de bzhin smra ba ste/ /ro lta bu ni 'di la don sems yin/ /de lta bas na smra la dga' spangs te/ /rtag tu bag yod byos la don soms shig /ces gsungs so/ /tshul 'di mang thos sgrub pa dang bral ba/ /

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 125tshogs ma bsags kyi bu ston kha ches bris/ /dge bas myur du shi 'phos dga' ldan du/ /mi pham chos kyi dga' ston myong bar shog /chos kyi 'byung gnas gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod las/ 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul nges par bstan pa rdzogs so// //

dam chos 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul/ 125tshogs ma bsags kyi bu ston kha ches bris/ /dge bas myur du shi 'phos dga' ldan du/ /mi pham chos kyi dga' ston myong bar shog /chos kyi 'byung gnas gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod las/ 'chad nyan la 'jug tshul nges par bstan pa rdzogs so// //

༄7/ /blo ldan chos la bskul ba'i bslab bya tshig gsum gnad don zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /gang la skyabs na nam yang mi bslu ba'i/ /dkon mchog rin chen gsum la gus btud nas/ /blo ldan skyes bu chos la bskul ba'i phyir/ /gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum bshad kyis nyon/ /dang po dal ba'i rten bzang rnyed pa dka'/ /bar du dam pa'i chos la spyod pa dka'/ /tha mar chos kyi gnad don shes par dka'/ /da res chos kyi gnad don shes 'dod na/ /shes bya'i gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /dang por bla ma mtshan ldan bsten pa dang / /bar du bla ma dpe char bsten pa dang / /tha mar bla ma rang sems bsten gsungs pas/ /tsho/ dang po mtshan ldan bla ma bsten pa la'ang / /bsten bya'i gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /dang po bla ma brtags la mkhas pa dang / /bar du bla ma bsten la mkhas pa dang / /tha mar dgongs spyod bslab la mkhas gsungs pas/ /dang po bla ma brtags shing dpyad pa la'ang / /dpyad yul gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /rab ni sangs rgyas 'bring ni byang sems dang / /tha mar so skye'i bla ma yin par gsungs/ /dang po gnyis ni brtags kyang mi dgos la/ /re zhig mjal ba'i skal ba'ang med pas na/ /da lta so skye'i bla mar bsten gsungs pas/ /so skye'i bla ma brtags shing dpyad pa la/ /thog mar bla ma'i mtshan nyid shes dgos pas/ /rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i mdo rgyan las/ /bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan brtson bcas lhag par lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra

128 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ngal spangs la bsten/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang mtshan nyid mang yod kyang / /mdo rgyud rnams las byung ba'i mtshan nyid kun/ /deng sang snyigs ma'i dus su dkon par gsungs/ /'o na ji ltar brtag par bya zhe na/ /brtag bya'i gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /dang por de la yon tan ci 'dug brtag /bar du nyes pa'i skyon la ci 'dug brtag /tha mar skyon dang yon tan gang mang brtag /de la yon tan mang ba'i phyogs nyid du/ /bsten bya yin tshul mdo las 'di skad gsungs/ /de lta'i yon tan ma lus ldan pa dag /rtsod pa'i dus su shin tu dkon pa ste/ /yon tan phyed dam brgyad cha bzhi cha can/ /de lta bu ni bsngags pa'i grogs su bsten/ /ces gsungs gzhan yang don dam bsnyen pa las/ /rtsod dus dbang gis bla ma skyon yon 'dres/ /rnam pa kun tu sdig med yod ma yin/ /gang phyir yon tan lhag par legs dpyad nas/ /bu rnams kyis ni de la bsten zhes gsungs/ /des na bsten bya'i bla ma gser bzhin du/ /ma brtags pa ni slob ma'i bdud yin gsungs/ /log pa'i bshes dang phrad na phung bar 'gyur/ /dper na sor mo'i phreng ba'ang log pa yi/ /bshes dang phrad pa'i tha mar phung bar bzhin/ /de bas da lta gong nas legs par brtags/ /de yis dang po bla ma brtags tshul bstan/ /lje/ gnyis pa bar du bla ma bsten tshul la'ang / /bsten lugs gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /dang po dad pa bar du snying rus dang / /tha mar bka' bzhin sgrub pa gsum du gsungs/ /dang po dad pa 'gyur ldog med pa ni/ /rtag tu ngu dang chos 'phags lta bu dgos/ /bar du chos spyod dka' spyad nus pa ni/ /rje btsun mi la yab sras lta bu dgos/ /tha mar ci gsungs bka' bzhin sgrub pa ni/ /mchog

bslab bya tshig gsum gnad don/ 129gzigs rnam gnyis mjal ba lta bu dgos/ /dgos pa de gsum tshang ba'i slob ma des/ /de nyid rtogs la dka' ba med ces gsungs/ /bsten nas bla ma mnyes pa sgrub pa la'ang / /bsgrub bya gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /rab ni sgrub pa'i zhabs tog brtson pa dang / /'bring ni sgyu lus tha ma zang zing gis/ /zhabs tog rnam gsum sgrub par mdo rgyan las/ /bkur sti rnyed pa dag dang rim gro dang / /sgrub pa'i sgo nas bshes gnyen bsten par gsungs/ /dang po sgrub pa'i zhabs tog brtson pa la'ang / /brtson tshul gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /dang po mdo sngags gzhung la thos pa sbyangs/ /gnyis pa thos don bsam pas gtan la dbab/ /gsum pa bsam bzhin bsgom pas nyams su len/ /dang po thos pa gang la sbyangs she na/ /sbyang bya'i gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /sbyong byed gang zag rab 'bring tha gsum las/ /rab kyis rig pa'i gnas chen gsum la sbyangs/ /de yang tshar gcod pa dang rjes 'dzin dang / /kun shes rig gnas gsum la mkhas par gsungs/ /bslab par bya ba'i shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag /gsum po 'di nang yang dag 'du bar 'gyur/ /de las lhag par kun shes rig gnas la/ /mkhas par sbyangs pas gnas skabs mthar thug gi /don dam dgos pa mtha' dag 'grub par 'gyur/ /don dam dgos pa gang zhig 'grub ce na / /gnas skabs mkhas pa'i khri 'phangs mthon po dang / /mthar thug grub pa'i sa mthor dbang bar 'gyur/ /mkhas pa'i khri la gang gis dbang snyam na/ /sbyangs 'bras mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum gyis dbang / /'chad pa'i gzhung lugs brgya phrag sgo 'byed cing / /rtsod pas gzhan sde'i lce brgya drungs nas 'byin/ /rtsom pas rgyal bstan brgya phrag gsal byed pa/ /de ni gnas skabs mkhas pa'i yon tan no/ /

bslab bya tshig gsum gnad don/ 129gzigs rnam gnyis mjal ba lta bu dgos/ /dgos pa de gsum tshang ba'i slob ma des/ /de nyid rtogs la dka' ba med ces gsungs/ /bsten nas bla ma mnyes pa sgrub pa la'ang / /bsgrub bya gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /rab ni sgrub pa'i zhabs tog brtson pa dang / /'bring ni sgyu lus tha ma zang zing gis/ /zhabs tog rnam gsum sgrub par mdo rgyan las/ /bkur sti rnyed pa dag dang rim gro dang / /sgrub pa'i sgo nas bshes gnyen bsten par gsungs/ /dang po sgrub pa'i zhabs tog brtson pa la'ang / /brtson tshul gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /dang po mdo sngags gzhung la thos pa sbyangs/ /gnyis pa thos don bsam pas gtan la dbab/ /gsum pa bsam bzhin bsgom pas nyams su len/ /dang po thos pa gang la sbyangs she na/ /sbyang bya'i gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /sbyong byed gang zag rab 'bring tha gsum las/ /rab kyis rig pa'i gnas chen gsum la sbyangs/ /de yang tshar gcod pa dang rjes 'dzin dang / /kun shes rig gnas gsum la mkhas par gsungs/ /bslab par bya ba'i shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag /gsum po 'di nang yang dag 'du bar 'gyur/ /de las lhag par kun shes rig gnas la/ /mkhas par sbyangs pas gnas skabs mthar thug gi /don dam dgos pa mtha' dag 'grub par 'gyur/ /don dam dgos pa gang zhig 'grub ce na / /gnas skabs mkhas pa'i khri 'phangs mthon po dang / /mthar thug grub pa'i sa mthor dbang bar 'gyur/ /mkhas pa'i khri la gang gis dbang snyam na/ /sbyangs 'bras mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum gyis dbang / /'chad pa'i gzhung lugs brgya phrag sgo 'byed cing / /rtsod pas gzhan sde'i lce brgya drungs nas 'byin/ /rtsom pas rgyal bstan brgya phrag gsal byed pa/ /de ni gnas skabs mkhas pa'i yon tan no/ /

130 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/grub pa'i sa la gang gis dbang snyam na/ /de yang grub 'bras sku gsum brnyes pas dbang / /ngo bo stong pas chos sku'i de nyid rtogs/ /rang bzhin gsal bas longs sku'i rtsal sbyong zhing / /thugs rje dbang gis gang 'dul skur grub pa/ /de ni mthar thug grub pa'i yon tan no/ /de yis dbang po rab kyis sbyangs tshul bstan/ /'bring gis tshul khrims rnam pa gsum la sbyangs/ /de yang nyes byas sdom dang dge chos sdud/ /sems cad don byed rnam gsum sbyangs la brtson/ /nyes byas sdom la ji ltar brtson snyam na/ /bstan pa'i rtsa ba dam chos 'dul ba la/ /gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spong bar khas len nas/ /khrel dang ngo tsha nges 'byung rnam gsum gyis/ /lus ngag mi dge'i las rnams sdom la brtson/ /dge chos sdud la ji ltar bcesan snyam na/ /rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho'i gzhung lam la/ /gzhan phan gzhi bcas sgrub par dam bcas nas/ /dran dang shes bzhin bag yod rnam gsum gyis/ /phyin drug bslab gsum tshogs gnyis lam la brtson/ /sems can don byed ji ltar brtson snyam na/ /sbyor ba sems bskyed dngos gzhi dmigs pa med/ /rjes la bsngo ba dam pa rnam gsum dang / /bdag gzhan mnyam brje bde sdug gtong len gyis/ /dngos dang rgyud nas sems can don la brtson/ /sbyangs 'bras myur du sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /de yis dbang po 'bring gis sbyangs tshul bstan/ /tha mas kyang ni bslab pa gsum la brtson/ /sdig spong dge sgrub rang sems 'dul ba la/ /brjod bya bslab gsum btus te rgyal ba yis/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin par gsungs/ /sbyangs 'bras bstan pa 'dzin 'gyur de dag ni/ /dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi sbyangs tshul bstan/ /de yang dbang po'i rim pa gsum bstan nas/ /bslab par bya ba che long tsam brjod kyi/ /don du

130 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/grub pa'i sa la gang gis dbang snyam na/ /de yang grub 'bras sku gsum brnyes pas dbang / /ngo bo stong pas chos sku'i de nyid rtogs/ /rang bzhin gsal bas longs sku'i rtsal sbyong zhing / /thugs rje dbang gis gang 'dul skur grub pa/ /de ni mthar thug grub pa'i yon tan no/ /de yis dbang po rab kyis sbyangs tshul bstan/ /'bring gis tshul khrims rnam pa gsum la sbyangs/ /de yang nyes byas sdom dang dge chos sdud/ /sems cad don byed rnam gsum sbyangs la brtson/ /nyes byas sdom la ji ltar brtson snyam na/ /bstan pa'i rtsa ba dam chos 'dul ba la/ /gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spong bar khas len nas/ /khrel dang ngo tsha nges 'byung rnam gsum gyis/ /lus ngag mi dge'i las rnams sdom la brtson/ /dge chos sdud la ji ltar bcesan snyam na/ /rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho'i gzhung lam la/ /gzhan phan gzhi bcas sgrub par dam bcas nas/ /dran dang shes bzhin bag yod rnam gsum gyis/ /phyin drug bslab gsum tshogs gnyis lam la brtson/ /sems can don byed ji ltar brtson snyam na/ /sbyor ba sems bskyed dngos gzhi dmigs pa med/ /rjes la bsngo ba dam pa rnam gsum dang / /bdag gzhan mnyam brje bde sdug gtong len gyis/ /dngos dang rgyud nas sems can don la brtson/ /sbyangs 'bras myur du sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur/ /de yis dbang po 'bring gis sbyangs tshul bstan/ /tha mas kyang ni bslab pa gsum la brtson/ /sdig spong dge sgrub rang sems 'dul ba la/ /brjod bya bslab gsum btus te rgyal ba yis/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin par gsungs/ /sbyangs 'bras bstan pa 'dzin 'gyur de dag ni/ /dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi sbyangs tshul bstan/ /de yang dbang po'i rim pa gsum bstan nas/ /bslab par bya ba che long tsam brjod kyi/ /don du

bslab bya tshig gsum gnad don/ 131sems can khams dbang bsam pa dang / /mos pa sna tshogs yod pas rgyal bas kyang / /chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs/ /de las rang gi dbang po'i nus tshod dang / /bstun par nyams su len par jo bos gsungs/ /tshe thung shes bya'i mtha' la zad pa med/ /tshe yi tshad kyang ji tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang pas chu las 'o ma len pa bzhin/ /rang gi 'dod pa ji bzhin blangs zhes gsungs/ /rang gi 'dod pa ji bzhin zhes pa yang / /dga' dga' skyid skyid 'dra na blangs rgyu dang / /skyo skyo sdug sdug 'dra na spangs rgyu byas/ /gsungs pa min gyi rang rgyud spang bya yi/ /gnyen por longs pa tsam zhig len la dgongs/ /deng sang thos bsam byed pa phal che ba/ /rtogs ldan lhag bsam zhabs kyis gsungs pa bzhin/ /re bas blangs shing ngal na dor byed pa/ /mdze yis shi ba'i skye bdun ro len 'dra/ /zhes gsungs ngo tig yin pas de 'dra bas/ /nam yang mkhas pa'i go sar sleb pa dka'/ /mkhas pa slob pa'i dus na dka' spyad dgos/ /bde bar 'dug la mkhas par mi 'gyur zhes/ /'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis gsungs mthong ngam ci/ /dpal sprul rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas kyang / /thos pas don chen sgrub pa'i dus tshod 'dir/ /'jig rten bya ba bgrang du mi khom gyi/ /thar pa mthun pa'i tshogs kyi lam chen du/ /thos pa kho nas rang rgyud grol dgos kyi/ /sgom pa'i ye shes cig car skye dka' bas/ /shes rab gsum las dang po thos pa mchog /ces gsungs gzhan yang deng sang snyigs dus 'dir/ /'gro ba'i bde skyid nyi ma dgung las yol/ /dam chos nyin byed snang ba'ang nub rir gzhol/ /dam pa rnams kyang zhi bar gzims nye dus/ /dam pa'i chos la mi brtson thabs ci yod/ /chos byed mi la sdang dgra lta bur mthong / /chos kyi dag snang bzang po'ang bar la yal/ /chos min snang ba lang tsho

132 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/mdzes pa'i dus/ /chos med gyi nar gnas pa cang phod dam/ /skye bo ngan spyod sna dgu mang ba dang / /chos byed mi la bar chad mang ba sogs/ /gang la bsams kyang dam pa'i lha chos la/ /brtson pa brgya 'gyur du ni bya ba'i rigs/ /brtson 'grus kyis ni dkar po'i yon tan dang / /mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bang mdzod rnyed ces gsungs/ /yon tan ma lus brtson 'grus rjes 'gro bas/ /tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa gang la yang / /myur bar myur bar brtson par bya 'os zhes/ /bskul ba'i lhag bsam rab dkar zla ba des/ /lag pad snying mtshor zum pa'i mya ngan gyis/ /ngag gi bung ba dbang med smre sngags bcas/ /khyod kyi sgra 'dzin lam du son pa'i mod/ /blo gros pad+ma'i tshal du bzung 'tshal lo/ /de yis thos pa sbyangs tshul 'phros don bcas/ /lung dang sbyar te mdo tsam bstan zin nas/ /lhe/ da ni gnyis pa bsam pa myong tshul la'ang / /myong lugs gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /dang por drang nges dgongs pa dgongs gzhir dpyad/ /bar du nges don kho nar blo thag bcad/ /tha mar bla ma'i man ngag spar 'dzin byed/ /dang po drang nges dgongs pa ma shes na/ /rgyal ba'i bka' la'ang log par rtog srid pas/ /bsreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin brtag zhes gsungs/ /bar du nges pa'i don la ma bzung na/ /drang don bslu 'brid nyid du mgo 'khor nas/ /ci byas 'khor ba'i rgyu ru 'gro bar gsungs/ /tha mar man ngag spar 'dzin ma byed na/ /nyams su len kyang yar skyed mi 'thon par/ /lam gol dman par lhung bar 'athru/ra zhes gsungs/ /gsum pa bsam bzhin 〉tem pa'i nyams len la'ang / /len tshul gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /dang por lta ba'i phu thag chod pa dgos/ /bar du sgom pa'i rgyun thag bsring ba dgos/ /tha mar spyod pa'i thabs la

bslab bya tshig gsum gnad don/ 133mkhas pa dgos/ /dang por lta ba'i phu thag ma chod na/ /nang gi de nyid rtogs par dka' bar gsungs/ /bar du sgom pa'i rgyun thag ma bsring na/ /rtogs pa rang byan tshud par mi 'ong gsungs/ /tha mar spyod pa'i thabs la ma mkhas na/ /rlabs chen gzhan don 'byung bar mi 'gyur gsungs/ /de rnams dbang rab sgrub pa'i zhabs tog gis/ /bsten nas bla ma dam pa mnyes tshul lo/ /'bring gis sgyu lus zhabs tog sgrub tshul dang / /tha mar zang zing zhabs tog sgrub tshul gnyis/ /zhib tu bshad na deng sang mi yi blor/ /gang bsams mi shes re zhig btang snyoms su/ /bzhag pas skyon dang yon tan gang yang med/ /shes par 'dod na sdong po bkodapa sogs/ /mjorgyud rnams las rgyas par byung bas gzigs/ /de rnams zhabs tog mnyes pa rnams gsum gyi/ /sgo nas bla ma bsten tshul bshad zin nas/ /7/ da ni tha mar dgongs spyod bslab pa la'ang / /slob tshul gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /dang por bla ma'i thugs dgongs zin pa dang / /bar du bla ma'i dgongs pa lon pa dang / /tha mar thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa dgos/ /dang po bla ma'i thugs dgongs zin pa la'ang / /zin tshul gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /dad pa che bas ci gsungs tshad mar 'dzin/ /brtson 'grus che bas thos bsam gnad du smin/ /shes rab che bas go stobs tshad ma rnyed/ /de gsum ldan na bla ma mnyes pa'i rgyu/ /de mnyes pa las kun mkhyen ye shes kyang / /'thob par 'gyur na yon tan gzhan lta ci/ /yon tan rin chen sdud pa'i mdo las kyang / /sangs rgyas chos rnams bla ma la ltos zhes/ /yon tan mchog mnga' rgyal bas de skad gsungs/ /bar du bla ma'i dgongs pa lon pa la'ang / /len tshul gnad kyi

bslab bya tshig gsum gnad don/ 133mkhas pa dgos/ /dang por lta ba'i phu thag ma chod na/ /nang gi de nyid rtogs par dka' bar gsungs/ /bar du sgom pa'i rgyun thag ma bsring na/ /rtogs pa rang byan tshud par mi 'ong gsungs/ /tha mar spyod pa'i thabs la ma mkhas na/ /rlabs chen gzhan don 'byung bar mi 'gyur gsungs/ /de rnams dbang rab sgrub pa'i zhabs tog gis/ /bsten nas bla ma dam pa mnyes tshul lo/ /'bring gis sgyu lus zhabs tog sgrub tshul dang / /tha mar zang zing zhabs tog sgrub tshul gnyis/ /zhib tu bshad na deng sang mi yi blor/ /gang bsams mi shes re zhig btang snyoms su/ /bzhag pas skyon dang yon tan gang yang med/ /shes par 'dod na sdong po bkodapa sogs/ /mjorgyud rnams las rgyas par byung bas gzigs/ /de rnams zhabs tog mnyes pa rnams gsum gyi/ /sgo nas bla ma bsten tshul bshad zin nas/ /7/ da ni tha mar dgongs spyod bslab pa la'ang / /slob tshul gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /dang por bla ma'i thugs dgongs zin pa dang / /bar du bla ma'i dgongs pa lon pa dang / /tha mar thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa dgos/ /dang po bla ma'i thugs dgongs zin pa la'ang / /zin tshul gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /dad pa che bas ci gsungs tshad mar 'dzin/ /brtson 'grus che bas thos bsam gnad du smin/ /shes rab che bas go stobs tshad ma rnyed/ /de gsum ldan na bla ma mnyes pa'i rgyu/ /de mnyes pa las kun mkhyen ye shes kyang / /'thob par 'gyur na yon tan gzhan lta ci/ /yon tan rin chen sdud pa'i mdo las kyang / /sangs rgyas chos rnams bla ma la ltos zhes/ /yon tan mchog mnga' rgyal bas de skad gsungs/ /bar du bla ma'i dgongs pa lon pa la'ang / /len tshul gnad kyi

134 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /brda sprod rig pas chig gi sgro 'dogs gcod/ /phar phyin theg pas grub mtha'i sgro 'dogs gcod/ /nges gsang theg pas nang gi sgro 'dogs gcod/ /sgro 'dogs de gsum chod pa'i slob ma yis/ /bla ma'i dgongs pa ji bzhin len par nus/ /ji ltar satsā'i brkos phor la yod pa'i/ /ris mo rdzogs par thabs kyis len pa bzhin/ /bla ma'i thugs la yod pa'i yon tan kyang / /slob ma'i thabs kyis len ces mkhas pas gsungs/ /de ltar ma zad rnam kun dam pa la/ /bsten pa'i mi la yon tan shugs kyis 'byung / /de dang nye na de yi yon tan rdul/ /ched du ma bsgos pa yang gos par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs mdo las gsungs shing yon mdzod las/ /ji ltar ma la ya yi nags klung du/ /rnam par 'khyams pa'i sdong dum phal pa yang / /yal 'dab brlan pa'i tsan+dan dris bsung ltar/ /gang la bsten pa de yi rjes su 'gro/ /zhes sogs bsten pa'i dgos pa smos mi lang / /tha mar thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa la'ang / /'dres tshul gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /dang por slob ma'i dad dang mos gus dang / /bar du bla ma'i thugs rje byin rlabs dang / /tha mar gsang sngags thabs lam dgung 'dzoms pas/ /slob mar bla ma'i byin rlabs 'pho zhes gsungs/ /de yang ā li kā li'i rgyud chen nas/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs 'pho nas 'tshang rgya ba/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas spar nas bton pa 'dra/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang mda' bsnun chen pos kyang / /bla mas smras pa gang gi snying zhugs pa/ /lag pa'i mthil na gnas pa'i gter mthong 'dra/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang rgyud chen de nyid las/ /rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ /tshogs bsags sgrib pa dag pa'i lag rjes dang / /rtogs ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na las/ /thabs gzhan bsten

bslab bya tshig gsum gnad don/ 135pa rmongs par shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang mdo dang bstan bcos las/ /dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin par gsungs/ /dad pa med na thugs yid 'dres thabs med/ /tse( rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i zhal snga nas/ /dad med chu dkyil rdo ril lta bu la/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung du med par gsungs/ /de yis tha mar dgongs spyod bslab tshul lo/ /de ltar bla ma mtshan ldan bsten pa'i tshul/ /mdo tsam lung dang bcas pa bstan zin nas/ /tsho/ da ni bar du bla ma dpe cha ru/ /bsten tshul bshad pa la yang bslab bya gsum/ /dang por dpe cha bla mar nges pa dang / /bar du dpe char bsten pa'i dgos pa dang / /tha mar bsten pas nges shes rnyed tshul lo/ /dang po dpe cha bla mar nges tshul la'ang / /nges lugs gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /'khrul med lam bzang ston par byed pas dang / /sangs rgyas dngos dang khyad par med pas dang / /bshes gnyen phal gyi do zla min pas kyang / /dpe cha bla mar nges so shes ldan rnams/ /de phyir dpe cha gzigs la nan tan bya/ /'khrul med lam bzang ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /bka' dang bstan bcos zhal gdams rnam gsum po/ /so so'i mtshan nyid las kyang zhabrul med mngon/ /dang po bka' yi mtshan nyid rgyud bla las/ /gang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zhing / /khams gsum dag na nyon mongs spong byed gsungs/ /zhi ba'i yon tan bsngags pa brjod pa gang / /de ni drang srong bka' yin bzlog pa gzhan/ /zhes gsungs bstan bcos kyang ni de nyid las/ /gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gis/ /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad/ /thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa/ /de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blangs/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang rtsom pa'i rgyu

136 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/gsum dang / /'chos skyob yon tan gnyis ldan 'ba' zhig gis/ /gsungs pas lam la 'khrul pa med phyir ro/ /gzhan yang zhal gdams rnam thar la sogs kyang / /grub pa'i rtogs brjod mkhas pa'i lag rjes dang / /mos ldan dang ba 'dren phyir ma gtogs pa/ /don med don log la sogs ngan pa drug /bstan pa'i bstan bcos nang pa'i lugs la med/ /sngon byon gong ma'i zhal gdams rnam thar sogs/ /phyis 'byung gdul bya'i nyams len yin pa ste/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud 'dra dam pa'i rnam thar sogs/ /ma mjal yid ches brtson pa mi 'byung bas/ /gong ma'i gsung la nan tan byas te gzigs/ /sangs rgyas dngos dang khyad par med pa ni/ /mdo las lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa na/ /nga ni yi ge'i gzugs su gnas zhes gsungs/ /gzhan yang dam chos pad+ma dkar po las/ /sku gzugs rnam pa mang po der sprul nas/ /'gro ba dge la spyod pa'i don byed do/ /zhes gsungs tshad mar gyur pa'i lung dag gis/ /sangs rgyas dngos dang khyad par med par grub/ /bshes gnyen phal gyi do zla min pa ni/ /yon tan rang bzhin lus rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi/ /spangs dang rtogs pa thams cad der bsdu bas/ /so skye'i bshes gnyen rnams dang brgya stong gi /cha yang mi 'gro dper yang mi phod do/ /deng sang bla chen phal la bsten pa bas/ /gsung rab yi ge'i glegs bam sna gcig dga'/ /'jug pa bde la khro ba'ang mi mnga' zhing / /'du 'dzi 'khor ba'i bya ba'ang dben pa dang / /zab dang rgya che'i don la'ang mi rmongs pas/ /gsung rab glegs bam rnam par bzhugs so 'tshal/ /bla ma las lhag bkur sti bya bar 'os/ /bar du dpe char bsten pa'i dgos pa la'ang / /dgos ched gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /dang por blo yi dogs pa bsal ba dang / /bar du nyon mongs gnyen por

bslab bya tshig gsum gnad don/ 137byed pa dang / /tha mar chos dang rang rgyud bsre ba'o/ /dang po blo yi dogs pa ma bsal na/ /gzhan la 'chad kyang long bas long khrid 'dra/ /rtsod kyang lte med pa ni tshig la dbul/ /rtsom yang lung rigs ji bzhin mi 'byor bas/ /kun dkris brgya yis 'thums pa'i rum nang nas/ /langs te khro med slob dpon la bsten nas/ /rig pa'i mtshon gyis lam gyi dka' gnad la/ /dogs pa'i tshang tshing bsal te dus kun tu/ /mkhas pa'i gyi ba rnam pa gsum po la/ /brtson par byed pa ya rabs mkhas pa'i lugs/ /bar du nyon mongs gnyen por ma song na/ /ji ltar mkhas kyang lhas byin legs skar bzhin/ /mchog la 'gran dang dman la khyad gsod dang / /chos dred song nas rang rgyud thul bar dka'/ /des na gsung rab lta ba'i 'dren byed kyis/ /nyon mongs skye ba'i go skabs la ltos te/ /chags can mi sdug sdang la byams pa dang / /gti mug la ni rten cing 'brel 'byung chos/ /sgom pas nyon mongs zhi bar mdo las gsungs/ /de'i steng sngags las nyon mongs lam khyer gyis/ /rang rgyud dul ba btsun pa'i yon tan la/ /brtson par byed pa ya rabs btsun pa'i lugs/ /tha mar chos dang rang rgyud ma bsres na/ /ji ltar btsun yang nyan thos rigs can bzhin/ /theg chen lam du tshud par dka' bar gsungs/ /theg chen chos kyi gnad ka 'ub 'dril na/ /chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems la thug /zhi lhas dam chos 'o ma bsrubs pa las/ /mar gyi nying khu lta bu byang chub sems/ /byung bar gsungs shing klu sgrub zhabs kyis kyang / /khyod kyi thugs dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis/ /sems ni chos kyi rtsa ba legs par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs byang chub sems la ma sbyangs na/ /chos gzhan gang gis 'tshang mi rgya bar gsungs/ /rma med sems kyis gzhan phan blo goms na/ /chos

138 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/dang rang rgyud 'dres par sla ba yin/ /gzhan phan lhag bsam bzang po'i yon tan la/ /brtson par byed pa ya rabs bzang po'i lugs/ /tha mar bsten pas nges shes rnyed tshul la'ang / /rnyed lugs gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /dang por thos pa'i dran pa gso bar byed/ /bar du bsam pa'i the tshom sel bar byed/ /tha mar sgom pa'i nges shes drong bar byed/ /de gsum rim bzhin dpe yis rig par bya/ /dang po sngar 'dris mi dang phrad pa bzhin/ /gnyis pa 'khon pa'i mi dang mdza' ba bzhin/ /gsum pa mdza' bor brtan por gyur pa bzhin/ /de yang gtso bo goms 'dris yin pas na/ /goms dang 'dris pa rab 'bring tha gsum las/ /rnyed pa'i nges shes de yang rab 'bring gsum/ /nges shes rab 'bring tha gsum de las kyang / /rtogs pa'i blo yang rab 'bring tha gsum 'gyur/ /zhi lhas rnal 'byor pa yang blo khyad kyis/ /gong ma gong ma rnams kyis gnod gsungs pas/ /rang gi blo la dgag bya med pa dgos/ /rang blor khas len bral ba'i gding rnyed na/ /de tshe lta ba'i phu thag chod pa yin/ /zla bas dgag sgrub gnyis ka dgag 'ba' zhig /don la dgag sgrub gang yang med ces gsungs/ /mi las don dam bden pa'i dbang du na/ /gegs pas sangs rgyas nyid kyang med ces gsungs/ /tha snyad bden pa thabs su gyur pa dang / /don dam bden pa thabs byung legs pa'i phyir/ /don dam gzigs par 'dod na tha snyad la/ /thos bsam goms 'dris dgos zhes bskul ba ni/ /kho bo'i snying gi man ngag yin pas na/ /don med chud zos ma btang nyams bzhes mdzod/ /de yis bar du bla ma dpe cha sa /bsten tshul lung sbyor mdo tsam bstan zin nas/ /

138 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/dang rang rgyud 'dres par sla ba yin/ /gzhan phan lhag bsam bzang po'i yon tan la/ /brtson par byed pa ya rabs bzang po'i lugs/ /tha mar bsten pas nges shes rnyed tshul la'ang / /rnyed lugs gnad kyi bslab bya tshig gsum yod/ /dang por thos pa'i dran pa gso bar byed/ /bar du bsam pa'i the tshom sel bar byed/ /tha mar sgom pa'i nges shes drong bar byed/ /de gsum rim bzhin dpe yis rig par bya/ /dang po sngar 'dris mi dang phrad pa bzhin/ /gnyis pa 'khon pa'i mi dang mdza' ba bzhin/ /gsum pa mdza' bor brtan por gyur pa bzhin/ /de yang gtso bo goms 'dris yin pas na/ /goms dang 'dris pa rab 'bring tha gsum las/ /rnyed pa'i nges shes de yang rab 'bring gsum/ /nges shes rab 'bring tha gsum de las kyang / /rtogs pa'i blo yang rab 'bring tha gsum 'gyur/ /zhi lhas rnal 'byor pa yang blo khyad kyis/ /gong ma gong ma rnams kyis gnod gsungs pas/ /rang gi blo la dgag bya med pa dgos/ /rang blor khas len bral ba'i gding rnyed na/ /de tshe lta ba'i phu thag chod pa yin/ /zla bas dgag sgrub gnyis ka dgag 'ba' zhig /don la dgag sgrub gang yang med ces gsungs/ /mi las don dam bden pa'i dbang du na/ /gegs pas sangs rgyas nyid kyang med ces gsungs/ /tha snyad bden pa thabs su gyur pa dang / /don dam bden pa thabs byung legs pa'i phyir/ /don dam gzigs par 'dod na tha snyad la/ /thos bsam goms 'dris dgos zhes bskul ba ni/ /kho bo'i snying gi man ngag yin pas na/ /don med chud zos ma btang nyams bzhes mdzod/ /de yis bar du bla ma dpe cha sa /bsten tshul lung sbyor mdo tsam bstan zin nas/ /

bslab bya tshig gsum gnad don/ 139tsho/ da ni tha mar bla ma rang sems su/ /bsten tshul bshad pa la yang bslab bya gsum/ /dang por snang ba bla mar shes pa dang / /bar du rang sems bla ma sgrub pa dang / /tha mar nges shes nang nas rnyed pa'o/ /dang por snang ba bla mar shes pa ni/ /snang grags dran no cog gi chos thams cad/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rol pa las/ /khyab gdal bsam mi khyab pa'i mos gus kyis/ /snang ba bla mar shes pa'i gnad ka 'dis/ /'khrul snang las kyi bag chags dag ces gsungs/ /bar du rang sems bla mar sgrub pa ni/ /mngon sum lam byed chos sku'i lam khyer dang / /rnam pa lam byed longs sku'i lam khyer dang / /mos pa lam byed sprul sku'i lam khyer gyis/ /rang rang dbang po'i rim pa dang bstun te/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgrub la brtson par bya/ /grub 'bras rang sems stong pa chos skur rtogs/ /rnam pa gsal ba'i rang mdangs longs skur grub/ /rtsal snang ci yang 'char ba sprul skur nges/ /de yis bla ma sems su nges pa ste/ /chos rjes bla ma rang sems dbyer ma phyed/ /gzugs skur 'dzin pa stor nas thal ces gsungs/ /tha mar nges shes nang nas rnyed pa dang / /ji ltar rang khyim phug na gter yod kyang / /mi des de ma shes pas dbul bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin skyabs kyi dam pa nang gnas kyang / /de ma shes pas skyabs gzhan 'tshol bar 'gyur/ /grub pa'i mda' bsnun chen po'i zhabs kyis kyang / /khyim nang yod pa phyi rol song nas 'tshol/ /khyim bdag mthong nas khyim mtshes dag la dris/ /zhes gsungs de la bla mas lung bstan pas/ /skye med rin chen mdzod dang 'phrad par 'gyur/ /de yang rgyu dang rkyen la ma ltos par/ /rang las byung ba'i rang byung ye shes ni/ /thog ma'i dus nas lhan cig skyes pa can/ /tha mal shes pa 'di ka bla mar mthong / /da ni su la'ang dri bar mi byed

bslab bya tshig gsum gnad don/ 139tsho/ da ni tha mar bla ma rang sems su/ /bsten tshul bshad pa la yang bslab bya gsum/ /dang por snang ba bla mar shes pa dang / /bar du rang sems bla ma sgrub pa dang / /tha mar nges shes nang nas rnyed pa'o/ /dang por snang ba bla mar shes pa ni/ /snang grags dran no cog gi chos thams cad/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rol pa las/ /khyab gdal bsam mi khyab pa'i mos gus kyis/ /snang ba bla mar shes pa'i gnad ka 'dis/ /'khrul snang las kyi bag chags dag ces gsungs/ /bar du rang sems bla mar sgrub pa ni/ /mngon sum lam byed chos sku'i lam khyer dang / /rnam pa lam byed longs sku'i lam khyer dang / /mos pa lam byed sprul sku'i lam khyer gyis/ /rang rang dbang po'i rim pa dang bstun te/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgrub la brtson par bya/ /grub 'bras rang sems stong pa chos skur rtogs/ /rnam pa gsal ba'i rang mdangs longs skur grub/ /rtsal snang ci yang 'char ba sprul skur nges/ /de yis bla ma sems su nges pa ste/ /chos rjes bla ma rang sems dbyer ma phyed/ /gzugs skur 'dzin pa stor nas thal ces gsungs/ /tha mar nges shes nang nas rnyed pa dang / /ji ltar rang khyim phug na gter yod kyang / /mi des de ma shes pas dbul bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin skyabs kyi dam pa nang gnas kyang / /de ma shes pas skyabs gzhan 'tshol bar 'gyur/ /grub pa'i mda' bsnun chen po'i zhabs kyis kyang / /khyim nang yod pa phyi rol song nas 'tshol/ /khyim bdag mthong nas khyim mtshes dag la dris/ /zhes gsungs de la bla mas lung bstan pas/ /skye med rin chen mdzod dang 'phrad par 'gyur/ /de yang rgyu dang rkyen la ma ltos par/ /rang las byung ba'i rang byung ye shes ni/ /thog ma'i dus nas lhan cig skyes pa can/ /tha mal shes pa 'di ka bla mar mthong / /da ni su la'ang dri bar mi byed

140 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/do/ /snyam pa'i nges shes skye bar 'gyur zhes gsungs/ /de dag gsang chen theg pa'i man ngag rnams/ /de tsam mi spro don gnyer can mchis na/ /mtshan ldan mnyes pa'i gsung las rtogs par bya/ /de skad gdams pa'i bslab bya'i skyes bzang 'di/ /stong gsum rin chen nor bus kyang bsgrun min/ /dam pa'i chos te yon ni gang gis kyang / /gzhal nus med ces skye rabs las gsungs shing / /gzhan yang 'jig rten 'di na'ang rang nyid la/ /phan par smra ba mang yang 'di lta bu'i/ /bslab bya ston mkhan e 'dug bsam blo thongs/ /de bas khyod kyis mkhas pa'i bslab bya las/ /blun po'i skya gtam dga' snang ma byed par/ /dga' dang gus pa'i sems kyis nyin re bzhin/ /bklags pas chos la blo kha phyogs par 'gyur/ /de ltar bla ma rnam gsum bsten pa'i tshul/ /mdo tsam yi ge'i lam du bkod pa'ang / /chos smra'i btsun pa dge 'dun rin chen pas/ /slob bu bud+dhā'i ming can nyid la gdams/ /'di bris dge bas mkha' khyab yid can kun/ /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /mjal nas 'bral med chos la longs spyod de/ /sa lam 'bras smin mthar phyin sku brnyes shog /zhus dag shu r+ghaṃ// //

140 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/do/ /snyam pa'i nges shes skye bar 'gyur zhes gsungs/ /de dag gsang chen theg pa'i man ngag rnams/ /de tsam mi spro don gnyer can mchis na/ /mtshan ldan mnyes pa'i gsung las rtogs par bya/ /de skad gdams pa'i bslab bya'i skyes bzang 'di/ /stong gsum rin chen nor bus kyang bsgrun min/ /dam pa'i chos te yon ni gang gis kyang / /gzhal nus med ces skye rabs las gsungs shing / /gzhan yang 'jig rten 'di na'ang rang nyid la/ /phan par smra ba mang yang 'di lta bu'i/ /bslab bya ston mkhan e 'dug bsam blo thongs/ /de bas khyod kyis mkhas pa'i bslab bya las/ /blun po'i skya gtam dga' snang ma byed par/ /dga' dang gus pa'i sems kyis nyin re bzhin/ /bklags pas chos la blo kha phyogs par 'gyur/ /de ltar bla ma rnam gsum bsten pa'i tshul/ /mdo tsam yi ge'i lam du bkod pa'ang / /chos smra'i btsun pa dge 'dun rin chen pas/ /slob bu bud+dhā'i ming can nyid la gdams/ /'di bris dge bas mkha' khyab yid can kun/ /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /mjal nas 'bral med chos la longs spyod de/ /sa lam 'bras smin mthar phyin sku brnyes shog /zhus dag shu r+ghaṃ// //

༄༅/ /bla slob chos gsum gyi rab dbye gsal byed lung gi phreng ba bzhugs so/ /na ma7gle man sa gu ru ye/ rgyal ba'i thugs rje sprin phung g.yo ba las/ /ma 'dris 'gro la phan bde gru char gyis/ /klog sbong bshes gnyen rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ /thar 'dod skye bo rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /gang la gang gis bsten pa'i mtshan nyid dang / /ston 'khor chos kyi 'chad nyan bya ba'i tshul/ /mdo tsam yid ches lung gis gsal bar bya/ /zhes dam pa'i yul la mchod par brjod pa dang /dgos 'brel khyad par can gyi dam bca'i tshig sngon du btang nas/'dir gang zhig gleng bar bya ba ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang don du gnyer ba'i gang zag shes ldan rnams kyis thog mar dam pa'i chos la 'jug pa'i sgo bla slob kyi mtshan nyid bshad pa la don gsum/ gang la bsten par bya ba bla ma'i mtshan nyid/ gang gis bsten par byed pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ bsten nas 'chad nyan ji ltar bya tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ thog mar bla ma brtag tshul/ bar du bla ma bsten tshul/ tha mar bla ma'i dgongs pa len tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid bshad pa dang / mtshan nyid de dang ldan mi ldan brtag tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sdong po bkod pa las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams pa la rag las so/ /zhes dang / yum bar pa las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pas/ thog ma nyid

142 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/du dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten par bya/ dad par bya/ bsnyen bkur bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de la dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid kyang so thar gyi skabs su/ 'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa me tog phreng rgyud las/ tshul khrims dag cing 'dul ba'i cho ga shes/ /nad par snying brtse 'khor la byams pa dang / /chos dang zang zing phan 'dogs brtson pa dang / /dus su 'doms pa gang yin bla mar bsngags/ /zhes mtshan nyid lnga ldan du gsungs pa dang / rgya chen spyod pa'i lugs la/ lam sgron las/ sdom pa'i cho ga la mkhas dang / /bdag nyid gang zhig sdom la gnas/ /sdom pa 'bogs bzod snying rje ldan/ /bla ma bzang po shes par bya/ /zhes mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du gsungs pa dang / zab mo lta ba'i lugs la/spyod 'jug las/ rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /theg chen don la mkhas pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs dag /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo / /zhes mtshan nyid gnyis ldan du gsungs pa dang / mdor na theg pa chen po'i lam ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan brtson bcas lhag par lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ngal spang la bsten/ /zhes mtshan nyid bdun ldan du gsungs pa dang / de'i steng du sngags sdom gyi skabs su/ brtag gnyis las/ rang 'dod lha mnyam rnal 'byor pa/ /rab mthong sngags kyi pha rol son/ /zhes mtshan nyid gsum ldan du gsungs pa dang /spyir btang gsang sngags ston pa'i slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ brtan zhing dul ba blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying brtse ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /zhes mtshan

142 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/du dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten par bya/ dad par bya/ bsnyen bkur bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de la dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid kyang so thar gyi skabs su/ 'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa me tog phreng rgyud las/ tshul khrims dag cing 'dul ba'i cho ga shes/ /nad par snying brtse 'khor la byams pa dang / /chos dang zang zing phan 'dogs brtson pa dang / /dus su 'doms pa gang yin bla mar bsngags/ /zhes mtshan nyid lnga ldan du gsungs pa dang / rgya chen spyod pa'i lugs la/ lam sgron las/ sdom pa'i cho ga la mkhas dang / /bdag nyid gang zhig sdom la gnas/ /sdom pa 'bogs bzod snying rje ldan/ /bla ma bzang po shes par bya/ /zhes mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du gsungs pa dang / zab mo lta ba'i lugs la/spyod 'jug las/ rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /theg chen don la mkhas pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs dag /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo / /zhes mtshan nyid gnyis ldan du gsungs pa dang / mdor na theg pa chen po'i lam ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan brtson bcas lhag par lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ngal spang la bsten/ /zhes mtshan nyid bdun ldan du gsungs pa dang / de'i steng du sngags sdom gyi skabs su/ brtag gnyis las/ rang 'dod lha mnyam rnal 'byor pa/ /rab mthong sngags kyi pha rol son/ /zhes mtshan nyid gsum ldan du gsungs pa dang /spyir btang gsang sngags ston pa'i slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ brtan zhing dul ba blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying brtse ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /zhes mtshan

bla slob chos gsum gyi rab dbye gsal byed/ 143nyid bdun ldan du bshad do/ /khyad par bka' brgyud rin po che'i lugs la/mchog gsang nang gi de nyid ston pa'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ chos rje gtsang pas/rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba/ thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba/ rten 'brel thabs la mkhas pa/ 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ste/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du bzhed pa dang / mdor na mnyam med dwags po rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ rtogs pa thugs rje ldan pa'i bla ma bsten/ /zhes mtshan nyid gnyis ldan du gsungs so/ /gnyis pa mtshan nyid de dang ldan mi ldan brtags tshul ni/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ bla ma dang ni slob ma dag /mtshungs par dam tshig nyams gyur pas/ /dpa' bos dang po bla ma dang / /slob ma'i 'brel pa brtag par bya/ /zhes dang / don dam bsnyen pa las/ de phyir slob mas 'dod pa'i bla ma gser bzhin du/ /legs par brtags na sdig pa cung zad yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / mdo las/ bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /legs par brtags la nga yi bka'/ /blang bar bya yis gus phyir min/ /zhes dang / yang mdo las/ de lta'i yon tan ma lus ldan pa dag /rtsod pa'i dus su shin tu dkon pa ste/ /yon tan phyed dam brgyad cha bzhi cha can/ /de lta bu ni bsngags pa'i grogs su brtag /ces dang / don dam bsnyen pa las/ rtsod dus dbang gis bla ma skyon yon 'dres/ /rnam pa kun tu sdig med yod ma yin/ /yon tan lhag pa gang yin legs brtag nas/ /bu rnams kyis ni de la bsten par bya/ /zhes so/ /mtshan nyid de dag dang mi ldan pa ni spang bya ste/ yon tan mdzod las/ de phyir dam pa legs par ma brtags na/ /dad pa can gyi dge tshogs chud gson te/ /dal ba skabs shig rnyed pa sbrul gdug dang / /shing gi grib ma nor bzhin bslu bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ blo ldan

144 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/slob mas bla ma ni/ /snying rje med cing khro zhing gtum/ /khengs shing chags dang ma bsdams dang / /spyoms dang bcas la mi bsten no/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa bar du bla ma bsten tshul la gnyis/ bsten pa'i dgos pa dang /dgos pa de ldan gyis bla ma bsten tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sdud pa las/ slob ma bzang po bla mar gus ldan de dag gis/ /bla ma mkhas pa dag la rtag tu bsten par bya/ /ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las byung / /sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la bsten to zhes/ /yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal bas de skad gsungs/ /zhes dang / bshes spying las/dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par tshangs pa spyod/ /yongs su rdzogs par thub pas gsungs de phyir/ /skyes bu dam pa bsten bgyi rgyal ba la/ /brten nas rab tu mang pos zhi ba thob/ /ces dang / don dam bsnyen pa las/ 'dod pa'i dngos grub slob dpon zhal gyi rjes 'brangs par/ /ma lus rdo rje theg par thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs/ /zhes dang / skyes rabs las/ dam pa rnams ni sus kyang mi bsring ste/ /dul ba'i tshul gyis bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ /de dang nye na de yi yon tan rdul/ /ched du ma bsgos pa yang gos par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sdud pa las/nad pa'i tshogs kyis nad rnams gso phyir sman pa bsten pa ltar/ /g.yo ba med pa'i sems kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ /zhes dang / yon tan mdzod las/ ji ltar ma la ya yi nags klung du/ /rnam par 'khyams pa'i sdong dum phal pa yang / /yal 'dab brlan pa'i tsan+dan dris bsus ltar/ /gang la brten pa de yi rjes su 'gro/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa dgos pa de ldan gyis bla ma bsten tshul ni/ ye shes grub pa las/ skya

bla slob chos gsum gyi rab dbye gsal byed/ 145ba 'dzin pa med pa ni/ /gru yis pha rol phyin mi 'gyur/ /yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs kyang / /bla ma med na srid thar min/ /zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ bkur sti rnyed pa dag dang rim 'gro dang / /sgrub pa'i sgo nas bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ /zhes dang / bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ 'dir mang smos pas ci zhig bya/ /bla ma mnyes byed gang yin bya/ /ma mnyes byed kun spangs nas ni/ /bla ma yongs su mnyes par bya/ /zhes dang / dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brangs zhes/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyis gsungs/ /shes nas dngos po thams cad kyis/ /bla ma yongs su mnyes par bya/ /zhes dang / zhi ba lhas/ dpal 'byung ba yi rnam tharalas/ /bla ma bsten pa'i tshul ltar bslab/ /ces dang / bslab pa gang la dad pa yi/ /gzhung nyid bla ma dag las nyon/ /ces dang / rgyud las/ bla ma'i yon tan thams cad bzung / /skyon ni nam yang mi sems shing / /yon tan bzung na dngos grub thob/ /skyon gyis dngos grub nyams par byed/ /ces dang / sdom 'byung las/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs te/ /bla mar mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gal po las/gang phyir rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /de ni slob dpon gzugs bzung nas/ /sems can phan gdags dmigs nas ni/ /tha mal pa yi gzugs su gnas/ /zhes dang /rgyud las/ bskal pa bye ba rgyal rnams la/ /rin chen zhing mchog phul ba bas/ /bla ma'i sku la til mar gyi/ /thigs pas mchod pa bsod nams mchog /ces dang /bla med mdzad pa'i slob dpon ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod na/ /de yis bsod nams ma byas shing / /dka' thub ma bsten ci zhig yod/ /ces dang / de lta bu'i bla ma la log par bltas na sdig pa che ste/ rgyud las/ tshigs bcad gcig

146 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/tsam bstan pa la'ang / /bla ma dag tu ma 'dzin na/ /khyi yi skye ba brgyar blangs te/ /rme sha can du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / nam yang slob dpon dag gi ni/ /kun tu sems dkrugs mi bya ste/ /gal te rmongs pas byas gyur na/ /dmyal bar nges par 'tshed par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / bla ma'i gzims cha stan dang lham/ /'goms shing co 'dri byed na ni/ /don rig dpal nyams gdon gyis zin/ /mchod rten shig dang 'dra bar gsungs/ /zhes dang / mnar med la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i/ /dmyal ba bstan pa gang yin pa/ /slob dpon la ni smod pa rnams/ /der ni gnas pa yang dag bshad/ /ces dang / gang gis bla ma la smod na/ /nad dang mkha' 'gro choms rkun dang / /gdon dang log 'dren dag gis kyang / /bsad nas sems can dmyal bar 'khrid/ /ces so/ /bla ma la smod pa tsam gyis nyes pa de tsam 'gyur ram zhe na/ 'gyur te/ dgongs 'dus las/ bskal pa stong gi sangs rgyas las/ /bla ma gnyan pa shes par bya/ /ci phyir bskal pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /bla ma dag la brten nas 'byung / /zhes rbe1/ /gsum pa bla ma'i dgongs pa len tshul la gnyis/ dad brtson shes rab kyis thugs dgongs zin tshul dang / mos gus rten 'brel gyis thugs yid 'dres tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rgya cher rol pa las/ srid pa'i gnas bcas dad pa chung ba yis/ /sangs rgyas yon tan shes par mi nus so/ /zhes dang / chos bcu pa'i mdo las/dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la/ /dkar po'i chos rnams ga la skye/ /sa bon me yis tshig pa la/ /myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no/ /zhes dang / dkon mchog sgron me'i mdo las/ dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad 'byung zhing

146 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/tsam bstan pa la'ang / /bla ma dag tu ma 'dzin na/ /khyi yi skye ba brgyar blangs te/ /rme sha can du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / nam yang slob dpon dag gi ni/ /kun tu sems dkrugs mi bya ste/ /gal te rmongs pas byas gyur na/ /dmyal bar nges par 'tshed par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / bla ma'i gzims cha stan dang lham/ /'goms shing co 'dri byed na ni/ /don rig dpal nyams gdon gyis zin/ /mchod rten shig dang 'dra bar gsungs/ /zhes dang / mnar med la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i/ /dmyal ba bstan pa gang yin pa/ /slob dpon la ni smod pa rnams/ /der ni gnas pa yang dag bshad/ /ces dang / gang gis bla ma la smod na/ /nad dang mkha' 'gro choms rkun dang / /gdon dang log 'dren dag gis kyang / /bsad nas sems can dmyal bar 'khrid/ /ces so/ /bla ma la smod pa tsam gyis nyes pa de tsam 'gyur ram zhe na/ 'gyur te/ dgongs 'dus las/ bskal pa stong gi sangs rgyas las/ /bla ma gnyan pa shes par bya/ /ci phyir bskal pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /bla ma dag la brten nas 'byung / /zhes rbe1/ /gsum pa bla ma'i dgongs pa len tshul la gnyis/ dad brtson shes rab kyis thugs dgongs zin tshul dang / mos gus rten 'brel gyis thugs yid 'dres tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rgya cher rol pa las/ srid pa'i gnas bcas dad pa chung ba yis/ /sangs rgyas yon tan shes par mi nus so/ /zhes dang / chos bcu pa'i mdo las/dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la/ /dkar po'i chos rnams ga la skye/ /sa bon me yis tshig pa la/ /myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no/ /zhes dang / dkon mchog sgron me'i mdo las/ dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad 'byung zhing

bla slob chos gsum gyi rab dbye gsal byed/ 147'phel bar byed/ /dad pa gter dang nor dang rkang pa'i mchog /lag pa bzhin du dge rtsa thams cad sdud/ /ces dang / rgyud bla ma las/ /rang byung rnams kyi ye shes ni/ /dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin/ /zhes dang / mdo las/ don dam pa ni dad pas rtogs par bya ba kho na'o/ /zhes dang / rgyud las/ bla ma nyid las ma byung ba'i/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya 'byung mi srid/ /srid pa'i kha lo gyen du ni/ /bla ma mtshan nyid ldan pas bsgyur/ /zhes dang / bla ma la gus yod gyur na/ /chos 'grub 'di la the tshom med/ /bla ma la gus med gyur na/ /bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / yang rgyud las/ blo dang ldan pa su zhig gis/ /bza' btung phud kyis bla mar mchod/ /'dir yang bza' btung 'phel ba dang / /phyi ma 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal thob/ /ces dang / dgongs 'dus las/ chos kun mi shes ma rtogs kyang / /mtshan nyid bzang ldan bla ma la/ /bkur bsti rim gro cher byas pas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho brgal bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / yang rgyud las/ chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba ni/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin par bshad/ /bla ma dag la ma bsten par/ /dngos grub rnyed par 'gyur mi srid/ /de phyir 'dod pa'i dngos grub ni/ /bla ma bsten pa nyid las byung / /zhes dang / ye shes dri med las/ mdzod ldan bla ma'i phyogs dag tu/ /bkur bsti rim gro sus byas pa/ /yongs su bgrang dang spyoms mi bya/ /byas na 'bras bu med par gyur/ /zhes rbe1/ /gnyis pa mos gus rten 'brel gyis thugs yid 'dres tshul ni/ skyobs pa rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ bla ma'i sku bzhi gangs ri la/ /mos gus kyi nyi ma ma shar na/ /byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun mi 'bebs pas/ /sems mos gus 'di la nan tan mdzod/ /ces dang / rje la gsol ba mi 'debs par/ /mi rtog ye shes 'dod pa

148 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/de/ /byang bstan phug pa nyi sgug 'dra/ /snang sems 'brel dus de la med/ /mos gus bya ba gnad du che/ /zhes dang / sgom sran gyis grol ba the tshom za/ /mos gus kyis grol ba the tshom med/ /ces dang / mi tri pas/ bla ma rje btsun ma bsten na/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis thob mi srid/ /ces dang / spyi bo'i gtsug gam lag pa'i mthil/ /snying gi dkyil du sus bsgom pa/ /sangs rgyas stong gi yon tan kyang / /gang zag de yis 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / ye shes mkha' 'gro mas/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan las rnyed pa cang mi srid/ /rnal du phob la gsol ba thob/ /ces dang / paṇa chen nā ro pas/ ci dgu thams cad bla ma la/ /gsol ba btab las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang /maitri pas/ bla ma'i byin rlabs 'phos te 'tshang rgya ba/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas spar nas bton pa 'dra/ /zhes dang / a li kā li rgyud las/ brjod bral lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ /tshogs bsags sgrib pa dag pa'i lag rjes dang / /rtogs ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na las/ /thabs gzhan brten pa rmongs par shes par bya/ /zhes dang / sa ra ha pas/ bla mas smras pa gang gi snying zhugs pa/ /lag pa'i mthil na gnas pa'i gter mthong 'dra/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs brten pa dang / /rang gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes dang / rang gi rig pa'i ye shes ni/ /ngag gi lam 'das spyod yul te/ /'di ni byin rlabs rim pa'i phyir/ /kun mkhyen ye shes de lta bu/ /zhes dang / chos rje gtsang pas/ rje bla ma'i ngo bo chos kyi sku/ /rdo rje 'chang dang zhal mjal bas/ /brgyud pa nye ring bgrang ma dgos/ /zhes dang / bla ma rang sems dbyer ma mchis/ /gzugs sku 'dzin pa

bla slob chos gsum gyi rab dbye gsal byed/ 149stor nas thal/ /mos gus bya ba'i yul ma rnyed/ /ces dang / rgyal dbang rjes/ bla ma rang sems 'dres tsa na/ /rang dang lhan cig gcig gyur pas/ /gsol ba 'debs pa'i yul ma rnyed/ /ces dang / da ni mgon po rang gi sems/ /ji bzhin rtogs nas ji snyed pa'i/ /mkhyen pa bdag la mngon gyur na/ /mchog gi dngos grub de ka lags/ /zhes dang / rje mi las/ bla mar nges so rang gi sems la ltos/ /sems las gzhan pa'i bla ma btsal kyang ni/ /rnyed par mi 'gyur lha rje ston pa ba/ /zhes dang / dpal sa ra ha pas/ bla ma'i lung la 'grims te rab 'bad na/ /lhan cig skyes pa byung ba the tshom med/ /ces dang / rim lnga las/ ri dbang rtse nas 'ga' zhig lhung gyur na/ /lhung bar mi 'gyur snyam yang lhung bar 'gyur/ /bla ma'i drin gyis phan pa'i lung thob na/ /grol bar mi 'gyur snyam yang grol bar gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa gang gis sten par byed pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid bshad pa la gnyis/snod ldan gyi slob ma ngos bzung ba dang / de las ldog pa spang byar bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon shākya 'od kyi zhal snga nas/ bla ma la gus tshul khrims yongs su dag /bsam gtan dang ni don la rtag brtson dang / /sgrims shing dul la bzod dang ldan pa ste/ /sdom brtson gnas pa'i chos ldan slob mar gsungs/ /zhes dang / mkhan pos/ slob dpon de nyid du 'dzin cing / /le lo g.yeng ba rnam par spangs/ /zo bzang dad pa la bsten pa'i/ /skyes bu de ni myur rtogs te/ /cig shos de las ldog pa 'o/ /zhes dang / yon tan mdzod las/ go cha che las blo gros shin tu brtan/ /lus dang srog la mi lta rim gro bgyid/ /ci gsung bka' dkri bdag nyid mi srung ba'i/ /skyes bu de ni mos gus kho nas grol/ /zhes dang / bla ma

150 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/shīn tu srung bas mdzangs pa dang / /bka' bkyon dag la mi khro rta mchog bzhin/ /gru lta 'gro 'ong gnas la skyo ba spang / /zam pa lta bu bzang ngan thams cad theg /bzo stegs bzhin du tsha grang gang yang bzod/ /bka' bzhin nyan pa bran khol lta bu dang / /nga rgyal spangs pa phyag dar lta bu dang / /dregs pa spangs pa khyu mchog rwa chad ltas/ /bla ma bsten zhes sde snod dag las gsungs/ /zhes dang / bla ma bzhengs tshe stan la 'dug pa min/ /bzhugs pa'i dus na bsnyun 'dri nyer spyad dbul/ /gshegs na zhabs 'bring sngon rjes g.yas nas min/ /stan dang bzhon pa 'goms sogs bsod nams nyams/ /sgo 'phar brdeg dang sgeg chos ngo 'dzum gnag /rdzun dang bab col bzhad gad bre mo'i gtam/ /spongs la sgo gsum nye bar zhi bas bsten/ /zhes dang / rdzing bu mchog la bsten pa'i ngang pa dang / /bung bas me tog bcud la ro myang bzhin/ /rtag tu 'grogs pa'i spyod pa ngo mtshar can/ /skyo ngal med par bla ma'i thugs bzung nas/ /dad pas nye bar len pa'i yon tan myang / /zhes so/ /gnyis pa de las ldog pa spang byar bshad pa ni/ yid bzhin mdzod las/ de yang nyon mongs shas che rang rgyud ngan/ /tshe 'di don gnyer srid las yid ma 'byung / /thos bsam chung zhing shes bya'i gnas la rmongs/ /dad brtson mi ldan dge tshogs ring du byed/ /ces dang / sgo gsum ma dul khengs dang bcos ma'i tshul/ /gzhan la gshe zhing dag snang mos gus med/ /zas skom nor dang log pa'i chos la sred/ /mi dge 'phel zhing dge legs 'grib pa ste/ /zhes dang / rang rgyud ngan zhing dag snang chung ba dang / /phyogs ris che zhing rang phyogs mchog tu 'dzin/ /bdag bstod gzhan smod yang dag chos sbong zhing / /theg chen dge ba'i bshes la

150 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/shīn tu srung bas mdzangs pa dang / /bka' bkyon dag la mi khro rta mchog bzhin/ /gru lta 'gro 'ong gnas la skyo ba spang / /zam pa lta bu bzang ngan thams cad theg /bzo stegs bzhin du tsha grang gang yang bzod/ /bka' bzhin nyan pa bran khol lta bu dang / /nga rgyal spangs pa phyag dar lta bu dang / /dregs pa spangs pa khyu mchog rwa chad ltas/ /bla ma bsten zhes sde snod dag las gsungs/ /zhes dang / bla ma bzhengs tshe stan la 'dug pa min/ /bzhugs pa'i dus na bsnyun 'dri nyer spyad dbul/ /gshegs na zhabs 'bring sngon rjes g.yas nas min/ /stan dang bzhon pa 'goms sogs bsod nams nyams/ /sgo 'phar brdeg dang sgeg chos ngo 'dzum gnag /rdzun dang bab col bzhad gad bre mo'i gtam/ /spongs la sgo gsum nye bar zhi bas bsten/ /zhes dang / rdzing bu mchog la bsten pa'i ngang pa dang / /bung bas me tog bcud la ro myang bzhin/ /rtag tu 'grogs pa'i spyod pa ngo mtshar can/ /skyo ngal med par bla ma'i thugs bzung nas/ /dad pas nye bar len pa'i yon tan myang / /zhes so/ /gnyis pa de las ldog pa spang byar bshad pa ni/ yid bzhin mdzod las/ de yang nyon mongs shas che rang rgyud ngan/ /tshe 'di don gnyer srid las yid ma 'byung / /thos bsam chung zhing shes bya'i gnas la rmongs/ /dad brtson mi ldan dge tshogs ring du byed/ /ces dang / sgo gsum ma dul khengs dang bcos ma'i tshul/ /gzhan la gshe zhing dag snang mos gus med/ /zas skom nor dang log pa'i chos la sred/ /mi dge 'phel zhing dge legs 'grib pa ste/ /zhes dang / rang rgyud ngan zhing dag snang chung ba dang / /phyogs ris che zhing rang phyogs mchog tu 'dzin/ /bdag bstod gzhan smod yang dag chos sbong zhing / /theg chen dge ba'i bshes la

bla slob chos gsum gyi rab dbye gsal byed/ 151bskur ba 'debs/ /zhes dang / gti mug can bsten thos bsam shes rab 'grib/ /zhe sdang can las ma rungs rang rgyud ngan/ /'dod chags can las yul la sred pa 'phel/ /nga rgyal can las phyogs res gnyis 'dzin 'go /zhes dang /de dag dang 'grogs thar lam bar du gcod/ /dge 'grib bde 'gro'i gnas kyang mi 'grub na/ /zhi bde'i byang chub 'grub pa smos ci dgos/ /des na sdig pa'i grogs po spang bar bya/ /zhes dang / ji ltar lam 'phrang bgrod pa'i mgron po dag /choms rkun 'jigs pas bcom la'ang 'jigs lta na/ /de yis tshe 'di'i nor dang srog 'dor gyis/ /gtan gyi bde ba 'phrog pa yongs mi nus/ /zhes dang /mdor na sdig pa'i grogs po brtags te spang / /de yi phan yon dam pa tshad med de/ /log par mi ltung rtag tu dge ba 'phel/ /dam pas bstod cing yon tan tshogs rab 'grub/ /ces so/ /gsum pa bsten nas 'chad nyan ji ltar bya tshul bshad pa la gnyis/ chos nyan pa'i tshul dang / thos pa'i phan yon bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dam chos pad+ma dkar po las/ gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /mdzes pa'i khri stan legs par bshams nas ni/ /gos bzang yid 'ong gtsang ma rnams bgos te/ /bcos ma'i ras sogs rnam pa mang bting nas/ /rkang rten bcas pa'i khri la 'dug nas ni/ /rtse gcig nyan pa'i 'khor gyi tshogs nang du/ /zang zing rnyed dang grags la mi sems par/ /byams pa'i sems kyis le lo med par ston/ /zhes dang / nyan po rnam g.yengs 'du 'dzi rnams spangs te/ /chos kyi mchod pa rnam mang rab mchod nas/ /phyag 'tshal drang por 'dug ste thal mo sbyar/ /ma yengs gus pa'i tshul gyis mnyan par bya/ /zhes dang / sdud pa las/
