152 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/dga' dang gus dang dad pa'i mchog ni nyer bzhag ste/ /sgrib pa nyon mongs bsal nas dri ma las 'das pa/ /'gro don mngon zhugs nges pa'i shes rab pha rol phyin/ /gang la dpa' rnams spyod pa de ni nyan par gyis/ /zhes dang / rtse mo'i rgyud las/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang po'i sems kyis nyon/ /brjed nges blo la he ru ka sogs dang / /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs/ /zhes dang / sa yi snying po'i mdo las/gcig tu dad cing gus pas chos nyan gyis/ /de la 'phya zhing skur ba mi bya'o/ /chos smra ba la mchod par bya ba ni/ /sangs rgyas 'dra ba de la 'du shes bskyed/ /ces dang / skye rabs las/ rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni rnam pa bskyed/ /dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta/ /tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin/ /rim gro bskyed de chos nyon cig /nad pas sman pa'i tshig bzhin du/ /rim gro bskyed de chos nyon cig /ces dang / spang bya snod kyi skyon gsum ni/ yum bar ma las/ legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig dang ngas khyod la bshad par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don man ngag rin po che'i mdzod las/ rna ba mi gtod kha sbub lta bu'i skyon/ /yid la mi 'dzin zhabs rdol lta bu'i skyon/ /nyon mongs dang 'dres dug can lta bu'i skyon/ /zhes dang / rnam bshad rig pa las/ nga rgyal dang ni ma dad dang / /don du gnyer ba med nyid dang / /phyi rol rnam g.yeng nang du sdud/ /skyo bas nyan pa dri ma yin/ /zhes dang / mi 'dzin pa lnga ni/ tshig 'dzin la don mi 'dzin pa/ don 'dzin la tshig mi 'dzin pa/ brda ma 'phrod par 'dzin pa/ gong 'og nor nas 'dzin pa/ log par 'dzin pa dang lnga ni spang bya'o/ /blang bya 'du shes bzhi ni/ sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bdag nyid la nad pa'i 'du

bla slob chos gsum gyi rab dbye gsal byed/ 153shes bskyed par bya'o/ /dam pa'i chos la sman gyi 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sman pa mkhas pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /nan tan nyams su len pa la nad nye bar 'tsho ba'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /zhes dang /log pa'i 'du shes bzhi ni/ yon tan mdzod las/ mi gzhi ngan pa'i zol sbyor tha gus lcis/ /bla ma spos kyi glang po ltar bsten nas/ /dam chos gla rtsi rnyed pa thob nas slar/ /rngon la yang dag spro ba'i dam tshig 'phen/ /zhes dang / phar phyin drug dang ldan tshul ni/ chos spyod kyi man ngag las/ me tog stan sogs rab 'bul zhing / /sa phyogs spyod lam sdom pa dang / /srog chags kun la 'tshe mi bya/ /bla ma la ni yang dag dad/ /ma yengs bla ma'i gdams ngag nyon/ /dogs sel phyir na skyon tshig 'dri/ /nyan po yan lag drug dang ldan/ /zhes dang / spyod lam gzhan bstan pa ni/ 'dul ba lung las/ ma gus pa la chos mi bshad/ /mi na bzhin du mgo g.yogs dang / /gdugs dang 'khar ba mtshon thogs dang / /mgo bo g.yogs pa dag la min/ /zhes dang / 'greng nyal dma' bar 'dug dang phyi nas 'ong / /lam gyi 'gram dang do ker zhwa cod pan/ /'phreng dang ral gri glang po rtar bzhon dang / /mchil lham 'khar gdugs mtshon cha ral gri dang / /dgra cha go cha gyon pa rnams la bshad/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa thos pa'i phan yon bshad pa ni/ mdo las/ ji ltar khyim ni legs gaskurdzogs pa/ /mun pas khebs pa'i nang zhugs na/ /mig ldan bzhin du malngardzong mi nus/ /de bzhin 'di nang rigs skyes pa'i/ /mi ni blo gros ldan gyur kyang / /sdig pa dang ni dge ba'i chos/ /ma thos bar du shes mi 'gyur/ /ces dang / ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las/ thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur/ /thos pas sdig

154 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/ las ldog par 'gyur/ /thos pas don ma yin pa spong/ /thos pas mya ngan 'das pa thob/ /ces dang / skyes rabs las/ thos pa ma rig mun sel sgron me yin/ /rkun po la sogs mi khyer nor gyi mchog /kun tu rmongs pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha yin/ /grags dang dpal dang gter gyi mchog kyang yin/ /ya rabs rnams dang phrad na skyes kyi mchog /tshogs kyi nang na mkhas rnams mgu bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / chos kyi dbang po'i zhal snga nas/ thar pa mthun pa'i tshogs kyi lam mchog tu/ /thos pa kho nas rang rgyud grol dgos te/ /sgom pa'i ye shes cig car skye dka' bas/ /shes rab gsum las dang po thos pa mchog /ces dang / mdo las/dam chos nyan pa'i dus dag gi /rnga'am gaṇ+ḍi brdung ba'i sgra/ /thos pas byang chub thob gyur na/ /nyan rnams lhag par smos ci dgos/ /zhes dang / so so thar pa las/ mang du thos pa nags kyi nang dag tu/ /lang tsho yol ba rnams kyis gnas pa bde/ /zhes dang / skye rabs las/ thos pa'i rjes su sgrub la nan tan sbyor/ /skye ba'i rdzong las tshegs chung thar bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /slar smras pa/kye lags gson dang shes ldan skyes bu rnams/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul ma nor bar/ /ci gsungs tshad mar 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /thar pa'i lam la 'dod dgur spyod cig dgu /zhes pa 'di'ang 'brug pha sding dgon byams khang bshad grwar rang ltos kyi slob bu rnams la phan pa'i lhag bsam gyis shākya'i btsun pa dge 'dun rin chen pas sug bris su bgyis pa dge legs su gyur cig/ //

dpe skrun smon tshig rig pa'i rdo rje gsung rab mdzod khang nas / /blo gros mtha' yas mdzod kyi lde mig ces/ /deb phreng 'phrul gyi par du bskrun pa'i dges/ /kun gyi blo gros gter sgo rang gar 'byed / /rig pa'i nor bu rigs drug thang mar brdal/ /ma rig rmongs pa'i dbul ba ring du bcil/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i brjod don kha rlangs nyid/ /mtha' yas skye 'gro'i blo yi mkha' la 'thul/ / rtogs pa'i chu khur snying rje'i sprin du 'khrigs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mdzad 'phrin char du bsnyil/ /las nyon mi gtsang dri ma dag par bkrus/ /mngon mtho'i lo tog lang 'tsho rab tu smin/ /mngon rtogs lam gyi skya rengs rab tu shar/ /sgrib gnyis mun pa'i sgo skabs dbyings su bcil/ /kun mkhyen rta bdun dbang po mdun bsus nas/ /chos kyi 'bor lo'i 'od zer 'bum du spros/ /ma sdo/sa sdug kun ljan ljin rab tu skems/ /

156 dam chos 'chad nyan bya ba'i skabs kyi nyer mkho gces btus/'phags pa'i tshogs kyi pad tshal rtsegar bzhad/ / mchog gsum snang ba mi nub rtag tu brtan/ /rdzogs ldan dpal yon nam mkha'i spun zlar shar/ /snyigs ma'i rgud tshogs mtha' dag dbyings su zhi/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bus 'dzin ma'i khyon kun gang / /chos kyi sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor pa rgyas/ / zab rgyas rgyu mthun cesas sku yun du gnas/ /'gro kun bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /'bras bu chos sku'i go 'phang mngon byed shog / ces pa'ang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i mdzod ces pa'i deb phreng rim byon gyi dpe skrun smon tshig tu 'jam mgon bla brang gi mkhan po'i ming tsam 'dzin pa blo gros rnam rgyal ne gi nas/ phyi lo 2008 zla 1 tshes 15 nyin bris pa dge'o// //

'i ketsho+o da 'i 5 ne po sgru trīrtse ོ gnas nas thas bsam byad pas lungag bstan pa dang 'dan la sgamartogs pa'i bstan pa 'dzin par byed dgos la/ de yang / thob pa wī'agrocan/ /ñjug pashes pa sngon 'grocan/ /zhes pa bzhinargyu'abras sugathog marathos pa nyid gal chezhing/ de la yanga'achad nyan jiltarabyaba'ichu mas ngag 'di nyidashinaram̐g4 so sna ༄rtsijirneterdzo rurīrīrisi hūṃlam̐— k+ṣ-ito pozhulkosnagekha —ga—( 3 ngh+ruwa 7
